title: Where to Find You Upon Descending the Mountain
description: A young woman fleeing her master encounters an unconscious man in the forest. Five years later, her act of kindness has unexpected consequences.
context:
Title: Where to Find You Upon Descending the Mountain
Description: A young woman fleeing her master encounters an unconscious man in the forest. Five years later, her act of kindness has unexpected consequences.

INT. FOREST - NIGHT

A dead campfire.

In the background, SONG YIN (20s) lies beside the unconscious GU HENG (20s). She suddenly wakes with a start, sitting up with a confused and frightened expression.

SONG YIN (V.O.)
Oh heavens, I only stole three fish and two chickens from my master, did you really have to deliver a corpse to my side?

She checks her bamboo basket frantically, then notices GU HENG's ashen face. Her fingers hover near his neck, checking for a pulse. She exhales in relief.

SONG YIN (V.O.)
Alive then. For now.

SONG YIN discovers an exquisite jade pendant on the ground, glowing faintly. She picks it up to examine it.

SONG YIN
What's this?

She looks at the jade pendant, then at GU HENG, as if realizing something.

SONG YIN
Didn't I say that caring for a man brings bad luck for a lifetime, and spending money on a man brings bad luck for three lifetimes? I can't let you latch onto me.

She tosses the jade pendant back onto GU HENG.

SONG YIN
Here, take it back. We have no karmic debt.

SONG YIN stands up to leave, but hesitates. Her gaze lingers on Gu Heng's pale face. She takes a chicken and a fish from the bamboo basket beside her.

SONG YIN
I'm being righteous enough. Fish, chicken.

She places the fish and chicken on GU HENG's body.

SONG YIN
Payment given, we're even, never to meet again.

As she turns, GU HENG's hand twitches, almost touching her sleeve. Song Yin doesn't notice.
continuation:
SONG YIN picks up her bamboo basket, turns, and runs off.

After she leaves, the pendant PULSES. The fish and chicken emit a strange glow, transforming into the shapes of a dragon and phoenix. The light flows into GU HENG's body. In the distance, OLD MAN SHEN (60s, white hair and long beard) quietly observes everything. He nods, as if a long wait has ended.

GU HENG suddenly wakes with a start, discovering a chicken perched on his chest. He sits up, confused, clutching the pendant.

GU HENG
My dream last night wasn't fake.

He stands up, holding the chicken in one hand and the fish in the other, and sees the jade pendant SONG YIN dropped on the ground.

GU HENG
But this... this was given freely.

He pockets the pendant deliberately.

CUT TO:

ON SCREEN: Five Years Later

EXT. THATCHED HUT - DAY

A large pot simmers with chicken soup, steam rising.

Two children (a boy and a girl, about 5 years old) lean over the pot, drooling with desire. They both wear simple jade pendants identical to the one from the forest.

BOY
Mommy, it's so good.

SONG YIN (O.S.)
Quiet, darling, we're sneaking a taste.

The wooden door of the thatched hut is pushed open. OLD MAN SHEN walks out.

OLD MAN SHEN
So, you do know you're sneaking a taste.

The two children and SONG YIN (off-screen) all look up in alarm.

SONG YIN (O.S.)
Master! I thought you were meditating until sundown!

OLD MAN SHEN
The dragon and phoenix in the soup told me otherwise.

title: Marriage Ad on Electric Pole Turns Out to Be Beautiful Boss

context:
Title: Marriage Ad on Electric Pole Turns Out to Be Beautiful Boss
Description: Su Han discovers he has a superpower that turns fake things into reality, leading him to respond to a suspicious marriage advertisement.

INT. SU HAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

Su Han lies in bed, his gaunt face lit by a cheap phone screen. A fan whirs in the corner. Overdue bills are stacked on a crate serving as a nightstand.

SU HAN (V.O.)
My name is Su Han. I've been scammed by online romance, phone fraud, and job scams. But from now on, I will never be scammed again. If anyone tries to deceive me, their lies will become true. Starting today, I will marry a rich and beautiful woman and reach the peak of my life!

Su Han jerks awake, gasping. He checks his phone—3:47 AM.

SU HAN
(whispering)
A dream... it had to be.

His thumb hovers over a "Red Envelope Game" scam app. He taps it. The screen glitches. Then—DING! DING! DING! Bank notifications cascade down the screen.

SU HAN
(stunned)
It worked... it actually worked.

Su Han scrambles out of bed.

SU HAN
(shouting)
Finally! My turn!
continuation:
A notification pops up: "Security alert: Irregular activity. Account suspended."

Su Han's face falls. He stares at the screen, then laughs—a hollow, desperate sound.

SU HAN
Right. Too easy.

He tosses the phone on his pillow. It lands face-up on a cached screenshot: "Lonely female CEO seeks healthy male for marriage."

Su Han's breath catches. He slowly picks up the phone.

SU HAN
Healthy. Male. Age 28.

A dangerous smile crosses his face.

SU HAN
Let's test this properly.

INT. SHEN RUMENG'S HOME - DAY

A sharp-eyed woman in a black silk robe, SHEN RUMENG, sits on a leather sofa. Her phone rings—"Unknown Caller" flashes on screen. Beside her, a printed copy of the same marriage ad.

SHEN RUMENG
(answering)
This is Shen Rumeng. You have thirty seconds.

title: Private Collection & Private Tasting
description: A woman running a bar reluctantly agrees to a marriage of convenience with an older man she's never met, only to encounter complications when a persistent suitor appears.
context:
Title: Private Collection & Private Tasting
Description: A woman running a bar reluctantly agrees to a marriage of convenience with an older man she's never met, only to encounter complications when a persistent suitor appears.

INT. BAR/SHU YANG'S HOME - NIGHT

Scene alternates between SHU YANG on the phone at the bar and her mother SHU MEI on the phone at home.

SHU YANG (V.O.)
An old man no one dares to marry—why volunteer myself as tribute?

SHU MEI
(on the phone)
He's thirty-six, Yangyang. And he saw your graduation photo. Wouldn't take no for an answer.

SHU YANG sits at the bar counter, phone pinched between shoulder and ear, wiping down a glass.

SHU YANG
(into the phone)
I'd rather auction the bar and sleep in the storage room.

SHU MEI
(on the phone, lowering voice)
The trust fund hits seven figures. Fully liquid. You'd never have to call your uncle again.

SHU YANG
(into the phone, flatly)
Do I look like I'm for sale?

SHU MEI
(on the phone)
One year. Separate residences. A post-nup that gives him nothing if he breaks the terms.

SHU YANG is silent, the glass forgotten in her hand.

SHU YANG
(into the phone)
Civil Affairs Bureau. Nine a.m. If he's late, I'm gone.

SHU MEI
(on the phone, exhales)
I'll forward the meeting details.

SHU YANG hangs up, pours herself a finger of whiskey.

SHU YANG
(to herself)
Seven figures for twelve months of theater. As long as he doesn't drool.

She knocks it back in one swallow.
continuation:
INT. BAR - NIGHT

Three men (PASSERBY A, B, and C) nurse beers in a corner booth, eyes flicking toward SHU YANG.

PASSERBY A
Third time this month she's closed alone.

PASSERBY B
Debts like hers don't leave room for a social life.

PASSERBY C
Debt's the least of it. Huo's kid comes every Tuesday like a mortgage payment.

HUO ZHEYU enters, roses replaced by a leather folio and the inevitable ring box.

PASSERBY B
Tuesdays, man.

HUO ZHEYU walks to the bar counter, places the folio between them.

HUO ZHEYU
Sister Shu Yang, the foreclosure notice is dated three days from now. My family's offer expires at midnight.

SHU YANG
And if I prefer bankruptcy?

HUO ZHEYU
(opening the ring box)
Then you'll remember that I offered. When no one else did.

EXT. BAR ENTRANCE - NIGHT

A black Maybach stops at the curb. The door opens; a polished oxford tests the pavement.

QI SHUO, thirty-something in a tailored coat, adjusts his glasses. A silver coin dances across his knuckles as he walks toward the bar.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

QI SHUO enters. The temperature drops.

SHU YANG looks up. Their eyes meet across the empty room.

SHU YANG
(internal monologue)
That bone structure. I've seen it on a museum wall I couldn't afford to enter.

QI SHUO's coin disappears into his palm. His gaze doesn't waver.

title: Destined Life
description: A martial arts disciple tries to save his master's student and her newborn child, but is betrayed and killed by his sworn brother who was deceived by their corrupt master.
context:
Title: Destined Life
Description: A martial arts disciple tries to save his master's student and her newborn child, but is betrayed and killed by his sworn brother who was deceived by their corrupt master.

INT. NANGONG YA'S RESIDENCE - DAY

ZANG LONG (a disciple of the Martial Arts Alliance) holds a baby in swaddling clothes, looking tenderly at his wife NANGONG YA beside him.

ZANG LONG
Xiao Ya. Thank you for your hard work.

NANGONG YA
This is the name my father prepared for him early on, Zang Feng. Hoping he will hide his sharpness and stay away from conflict.

Zang Long smiles and kisses the baby's forehead.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

Thunder and lightning rage outside.

HONG YING (Zhentian's wife) lies on the bed, screaming in pain, clutching a newborn daughter.

ZANG LONG (O.S.)
Hong Ying!

Hong Ying struggles, questioning her master QIU BAICHUAN (Leader of the Martial Arts Alliance) who stands by the bed, his face impassive.

HONG YING
Master, please. Zhentian is your finest disciple. This child is his bloodline...

QIU BAICHUAN
Her life force will complete my breakthrough. A small sacrifice for the Alliance's true power.

HONG YING
(desperately)
Someone save my child!

Qiu Baichuan's palm begins to glow with dark energy.

ZANG LONG (O.S.)
Stop!

Zang Long and Nangong Ya burst in. Zang Long intercepts Qiu Baichuan while Nangong Ya shields Hong Ying.

ZANG LONG
Master, we swore to protect the innocent. This is madness.

HONG YING
(to Zang Long)
Senior Brother... he's already killed three disciples who questioned him. He'll come for Feng'er next.

ZANG LONG
(realizing)
So that's why you wanted our son brought here tonight.

QIU BAICHUAN
(to Zang Long)
Two pure newborns in one night. Fate smiles upon my ascension.

ZANG LONG
(furious)
I would rather die than let you touch either child.

Hong Ying thrusts her daughter into Nangong Ya's arms.

HONG YING
Take her! Find Zhentian! He's in the northern village--

Qiu Baichuan strikes Hong Ying. She collapses, lifeless.

NANGONG YA
(to Zang Long)
We must take them both. He'll hunt Feng'er if we leave him.

ZANG LONG
Go!

Zang Long and Nangong Ya flee, each carrying a baby.
continuation:
EXT. BAMBOO FOREST - NIGHT

Heavy rain pours down. Zang Long and Nangong Ya stumble through the mud.

ZANG LONG
We reach Zhentian by dawn. He'll protect all of us from the master's madness.

Suddenly, CHEN ZHENTIAN (disciple of the Martial Arts Alliance) blocks their path, sword trembling in his hand, his eyes red-rimmed.

ZANG LONG
Zhentian! Thank the gods. Hong Ying is--

Chen Zhentian's sword flashes. Zang Long falls, the baby in his arms (Hong Ying's daughter) nearly dropping.

NANGONG YA
A Long!

CHEN ZHENTIAN
(voice breaking)
Master sent me her bloodied robe... her hairpin... and this.

He holds up a jade token - Zang Long's own disciple token.

CHEN ZHENTIAN
He said you murdered her last night. That you stole our child for a forbidden ritual. That you envied what I had.

ZANG LONG
(gasping, struggling to rise)
The master... lies... she died... protecting your daughter...

CHEN ZHENTIAN
(seeing the baby Zang Long holds)
That child... is mine?

He sees Nangong Ya clutching Zang Feng protectively.

CHEN ZHENTIAN
And you keep yours safe while mine dies? You planned this?

NANGONG YA
No! Feng'er is our son! That is your daughter in A Long's arms! The master killed Hong Ying before our eyes--

Zhentian's grief overwhelms reason. He strikes again.

CHEN ZHENTIAN
Master told me everything! Your false righteousness. Your hidden jealousy. Your betrayal!

Zang Long falls dead. Zhentian turns to Nangong Ya, tears mixing with rain.

CHEN ZHENTIAN
Now you will feel what I feel.

He pierces her heart. As she collapses, Zang Feng rolls from her arms, wailing into the storm. Zhentian stares down at the infant, his face a mask of torment and doubt.

title: The Commoner Physiognomist
description: A delivery man encounters a desperate heiress who refuses an arranged marriage, leading to an unexpected night and a confrontation about responsibility and fate.
context:
Title: The Commoner Physiognomist
Description: A delivery man encounters a desperate heiress who refuses an arranged marriage, leading to an unexpected night and a confrontation about responsibility and fate.

INT. XIAO YAROU'S HOME - NIGHT

Opening with a series of close-up shots of XIAO YAROU, wearing exquisite makeup, her eyes hazy—but a faint tremor in her hand betrays her.

XIAO YAROU wears a silk robe, lounging lazily on the sofa, holding a glass of red wine, gently swirling it. The liquid sloshes slightly unevenly.

Her phone on the table suddenly rings. She picks it up and answers.

XIAO YAROU
Hello?

MALE VOICE (V.O.)
Xiao Yarou, you're marrying Young Master Wang in three days. No matter where you are, come back immediately.

XIAO YAROU
(angrily)
The Wang family is a cesspool. I'd rather die than marry into it!

MALE VOICE (V.O.)
Then your mother's medical bills die with her. The wedding is non-negotiable.

XIAO YAROU
(quietly, voice breaking)
You bastard...

XIAO YAROU hangs up and angrily throws the phone on the table. It clatters loudly.

The doorbell rings.

XIAO YAROU
(impatiently)
Who is it?

DELIVERY GUY (O.S.)
Hello, your food delivery is here.

XIAO YAROU gets up and walks to the door to open it.

A young DELIVERY GUY stands at the door, holding a delivery bag. His eyes quickly scan her face—noticing the puffy eyes beneath makeup, the wine glass clutched like a lifeline.

DELIVERY GUY
Hello, this is our restaurant's signature fried rice.

Without a word, XIAO YAROU grabs the DELIVERY GUY by the collar, pulls him into the room, pushes him hard against the wall, and kisses him.

The DELIVERY GUY looks completely shocked—but his hand briefly hesitates near her trembling waist.

XIAO YAROU pushes the DELIVERY GUY onto the bed.

Quick scene transition, screen goes black.
continuation:
INT. XIAO YAROU'S HOME - DAY

The next morning, the DELIVERY GUY wakes up shirtless in bed, covered with lipstick marks. He sits up, looking confused. He touches his lips thoughtfully.

DELIVERY GUY
(to himself)
Peach blossom curse... but her face showed no joy. Only desperation.

XIAO YAROU walks out of the bathroom wrapped in a towel. Her makeup is gone, revealing dark circles and a pallor.

DELIVERY GUY
Last night was my first time. You have to take responsibility for me.

XIAO YAROU
(coldly)
I take responsibility for you? If you don't want to die, disappear before I change my mind.

DELIVERY GUY
(agitated)
Hey! You haven't even put your pants on and you're already denying everything? Last night it was me, the boss myself, who delivered your food, and you wore me out all night. My back is about to break.

XIAO YAROU ignores him and turns to walk away.

DELIVERY GUY
Hey!

The DELIVERY GUY gets dressed and stands in the room.

XIAO YAROU
Shut up.

XIAO YAROU takes out a bank card and throws it to the DELIVERY GUY.

XIAO YAROU
There's one million here. Enough to buy you a hundred food stalls. Leave now and disappear forever.

DELIVERY GUY
(shocked)
One million? You think I'm a gigolo? What happened between us isn't something money can solve.

The DELIVERY GUY throws the bank card on the floor.

XIAO YAROU
Then what do you want?

The DELIVERY GUY walks toward her step by step, his gaze tracing the exhaustion etched into her face.

DELIVERY GUY
I want...

Their eyes lock. The frame freezes. End.

INT. SPORTS ARENA - DAY

Inside the sports arena, the audience ROARS. Thousands of hands clap in unison. Flags wave like a crimson storm. Li Jiang stands frozen, trophy in hand, as if the moment might shatter.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
And now, the moment we've all been waiting for—your 2025 National Dabaijian Champions!

Four athletes (LI JIANG and his teammates) wearing red and yellow gradient sportswear stand in a row. Li Jiang's knuckles are white where he grips the trophy.

An AWARD PRESENTER walks forward and hands a golden trophy to LI JIANG, who stands at the front.

AWARD PRESENTER
Don't drop it, son. You've earned every gram.

Li Jiang stares at his own reflection in the polished gold, seeing a younger version of himself.

AWARD PRESENTER
(grasping Li Jiang's shoulder)
Your master would be proud.

LI JIANG
(voice cracking)
continuation:
Thank you, sir.

AWARD PRESENTER
(to teammates)
You boys made history today.

TEAMMATE
(pumping fist)
For Master Chen!

LI JIANG'S TEAMMATES
(in unison)
We promised him!

ON SCREEN: Dabaijian Promotion Ambassador Li Jiang

LI JIANG (V.O.)
(thick with emotion)
Master... the doctors said you'd never see this day. But you saw it first. Ten thousand times.

Li Jiang raises the trophy slowly, as if performing a ritual. His face remains stoic, but a single tear escapes.

The arena lights BLAZE. For a moment, Li Jiang is silhouetted against the brilliance, a solitary figure holding the weight of a promise kept.

title: The Secret of Club No. 9
description: At an elite club, a powerful woman named Tina selects male consultants from thousands of applicants, testing their skincare knowledge and ability to handle demanding clients.
context:
Title: The Secret of Club No. 9
Description: At an elite club, a powerful woman named Tina selects male consultants from thousands of applicants, testing their skincare knowledge and ability to handle demanding clients.

INT. TOP-TIER CLUB - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Feisi Club No. 9 - Private Consultation Wing

Fifteen MALE CONSULTANTS stand at attention along a mirrored corridor. Their black linen uniforms and translucent face shields create an anonymous, clinical line.

MALE ASSISTANT
Sister Tina. Final candidates from thirty thousand applicants.

TINA'S REFLECTION appears in the mirror before she does—gold glasses, sleek suit, assessing eyes. She walks the line with a digital stylus in hand.

TINA
Your face is your resume here. But resumes can be airbrushed. Skin can't.

Tina stops before CONSULTANT #7. His shoulders tense.

She lifts his face shield. Studies him. Her stylus hovers near his jaw.

TINA
(quietly)
This redness isn't acne. It's over-exfoliation. You panicked and tried to fix your skin last night, didn't you?

Consultant #7's jaw tightens.

TINA
Our clients can smell desperation. Thank you for your time.

She taps her stylus. He exits, dignity intact but defeated.

Tina settles into a leather chair, crossing her legs.

TINA
To those still standing—you've earned a lottery ticket. But the draw is tomorrow.

She gestures. The curtain behind her opens. A FEMALE CLIENT in a silk robe stands beneath a spotlight, her complexion visibly irritated and uneven.

TINA
Your client had a bad reaction to a $600 cream. She's already posted one-star reviews. You have thirty seconds.
continuation:
The consultants shift. Some whisper calculations. Others freeze.

CHU RUYE (mid-20s, calm, focused) steps forward one pace.

CHU RUYE
The flaking suggests barrier damage. The uneven tone means she's covering it with makeup, which is making it worse.

MALE CONSULTANT A
(whispering)
He's reading her, not just the symptoms.

MALE CONSULTANT B
(whispering back)
That's the difference between selling and solving.

Tina's stylus hovers over her tablet, ready to eliminate another.

TINA
Your solution?

Chu Ruye removes his face shield. His skin is healthy, not perfect—real.

CHU RUYE
Dafu Yan Jingxiu's B5 Intensive Repair. It's what rebuilt my barrier after I destroyed it with too many acid peels.

ON SCREEN: CHU RUYE
ON SCREEN: @RuyeBeauty - 12M followers

CHU RUYE (V.O.)
Proof over promises.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

A YUE (30s, sleepless, genius) stares through a microscope. His own reflection in the lens shows stress and passion.

ON SCREEN: A YUE - Dafu Yan Lead Chemist

MYSTERIOUS MAN (V.O.)
Your B5 prototype is outperforming our entire premium line in live trials.

A Yue looks up sharply. A mix of pride and fear crosses his face.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Rather Die Than Submit
description: A young girl confronts the Emperor on the street, claiming he is her father, shocking the crowd who believed he came to select concubines.
context:
Title: Rather Die Than Submit
Description: A young girl confronts the Emperor on the street, claiming he is her father, shocking the crowd who believed he came to select concubines.

EXT. ANCIENT STREET - DAY

SOLDIERS in crimson armor shove forward, their spear-butts thudding against cobblestones. DESPERATE WOMEN clutch hand-painted portraits and wilting lotus blossoms, pressing against the soldiers' shields.

SOLDIER
Make way! Make way! By order of the Crown Prince!

Shoving intensifies. A crone's basket spills—dates scatter, trampled underfoot.

From a shadowed doorway, YUEYUE (9, filthy, in threadbare hemp) clutches a silk scroll. She unrolls it: a vibrant imperial portrait with edges worn by countless secret viewings.

At the procession's head, PRINCE XIAO CHENGRUI (30s, cold-eyed) surveys the crowd like a falcon. Behind his mount, the Emperor's carriage—black lacquer, unadorned, its curtains sealed tight.

WOMAN A
(voice cracking)
Ten years... ten years since any woman entered the Jade Pavilion!

WOMAN B
(shoving a painting through a guard's arm)
The astrologers said the Phoenix Star aligns today! He must choose!

XIAO CHENGRUI wheels his horse toward the carriage, his voice low but cutting.

XIAO CHENGRUI
Imperial Brother. Mother grows desperate. You grace these filthy streets for temple incense while your throne stands heirless. She demands you return with at least three new consorts.

He straightens in his saddle, suddenly projecting his voice for the masses.

XIAO CHENGRUI
Hear this! His Majesty rides today for the Temple of Heaven's Blessing—not for any lowborn selection!

A groan ripples through the crowd. Hope falters.

XIAO CHENGRUI
(silkily)
continuation:
But should any maiden's... virtue... pierce his refined sorrow? She would be raised as high as the moon itself.

The crowd erupts. Women surge, paintings tearing, flowers crushed. The soldiers grin—more chaos means more bribes.

From the carriage, a voice like grinding jade.

XIAO JINGRUI (O.S.)
Enough, Chengrui. You play too long with mice.

Yueyue's knuckles whiten around the portrait. She whispers to its painted eyes.

YUEYUE
(to herself)
Mother died whispering your name. I won't.

She bolts. Small and quick, she darts between legs, past the soldiers' line—

XIAO CHENGRUI
(reining in his horse)
Whoa!

His horse rears, hooves flashing. Yueyue stands her ground, arms spread, holding the portrait up like a shield.

XIAO CHENGRUI
What gutter spawn—

The carriage door opens. EMPEROR XIAO JINGRUI (40s, face carved by years of solitude) emerges. His gaze finds Yueyue.

Her chin lifts. Tears cut clean tracks through the dirt on her cheeks. Her voice carries—clear, young, unbreakable.

YUEYUE
Father. Your daughter Yueyue has waited seven winters.

Silence. Even the soldiers freeze.

WOMAN A
(whispered prayer)
She called him Father. The gods forgive us all.

title: Bound by Heart
description: A peasant girl sold to a brothel is bought by a mysterious lord who forces her to impersonate a minister's daughter and marry the Crown Prince to retrieve a secret item.
context:
Title: Bound by Heart
Description: A peasant girl sold to a brothel is bought by a mysterious lord who forces her to impersonate a minister's daughter and marry the Crown Prince to retrieve a secret item.

INT. DRUNKEN FLOWER BROTHEL - DAY

Dust motes swirl in the lantern light. SU WANWAN, seventeen, calloused hands clutching torn hemp clothing, is shoved to the filthy floor. She scrambles backward like a cornered animal.

SU WANWAN
(pleading)
Father, please—not me! The spring planting isn't done. The well needs mending. Who'll care for Mother when the cough returns?

FATHER
(hollow-eyed, reeking of sorghum wine)
The fields are ruined. The well is dry. Your mother died last winter.

He delivers a numb kick to her ribs—more exhaustion than malice. She curls around the blow.

MADAM
(red lacquered nails tapping a wooden paddle)
First lesson, piglet. My house, my rules.

Su Wanwan bolts. A SERVANT'S meaty hand snags her hair. Another clamps her waist. She thrashes, kicking over a spittoon.

SU WANWAN
(between gritted teeth)
Let—me—go!

ZHAO JIN
(emerging from shadows)
Hold her still.

Outside, a carriage with no markings stops. The curtain parts a finger's width. HUAN CHU's gaze flickers over the scene like a snake tasting air.

MADAM
(sugar-sweet, bowing low)
My deepest apologies, my lord. Fresh stock, still feral. We'll have her docile by month's end.

HUAN CHU
(voice barely a murmur)
I'll take that one.

MADAM
(stuttering)
This... this one?

ZHAO JIN
(produces a silk pouch)
Her entire debt. Plus twenty years of your best earnings.

He spills golden taels like water. They clink against the floorboards, rolling. The Madam's eyes fix on the gold, then on Su Wanwan—truly seeing her for the first time.

MADAM
(hand trembling as she extends the contract)
Take her. She was born for better things.

ZHAO JIN
(tears the parchment once, twice)
Her past is ash.

Su Wanwan is half-carried toward the carriage. Her father lunges for a rolling tael.

FATHER
(to Madam)
You gave me two silvers! She's worth a hundred!

MADAM
(to Bouncer)
Break his fingers.

TRANSITION: Three weeks later
continuation:
INT. LUXURIOUS CHAMBER - DAY

Sunlight cuts through sandalwood incense, illuminating SU WANWAN in bridal scarlet. She doesn't touch the silk—holds herself as if the fabric might bite. Her reflection in the bronze mirror is a stranger.

HUAN CHU stands at the lattice window, a cut-paper silhouette.

HUAN CHU
The Grand Secretary's daughter died of fever last month. You have her name, her face, and now—her destiny.

SU WANWAN
(frozen)
You mean... the prince thinks I'm—

HUAN CHU
In three days, you marry the Crown Prince. You will be perfectly behaved.

SU WANWAN
(laughs, bordering hysteria)
I'll be dead in three days. They'll see through me before the first tea ceremony.

HUAN CHU
(turns, sword sliding from scabbard)
Then you'll die here instead.

The blade's tip catches the light, rests beneath her jaw. Su Wanwan's breath stills. Her eyes drop to the jade-inlaid hilt, then to his face—searching for bluff. Finding none.

SU WANWAN
(whisper)
What do you want from me?

HUAN CHU
The Prince keeps a jade seal in his private study. It opens a box. Bring me the box.

SU WANWAN
(swallowing against steel)
And if I do? If I'm lucky enough to live that long?

HUAN CHU
Your contract burns. You get fifty taels and a new name in a southern province.

SU WANWAN's fingers twitch. Her eyes calculate—fifty taels. A field. A house that locks. A life.

SU WANWAN
(very slowly)
I'm strong. I learn fast. And I've kept secrets before.

HUAN CHU
Three months. Fail, and your father doesn't die—he merely wishes he had.

SU WANWAN
(voice flat)
He's already dead to me.

HUAN CHU
(smile without warmth)
Then I'll take your hands instead. The Prince prefers docile wives.

SU WANWAN
(pale, but eyes steady)
I'll get your box.

HUAN CHU
Zhao Jin—take her to the governess. If she uses one phrase of village dialect, cut out her tongue.

ZHAO JIN
Yes, my lord.

Su Wanwan rises. Her hands shake, but she smooths the bridal silk with the same reverence she'd show a plow handle—tool of her survival.

SU WANWAN
(to herself, barely audible)
Just another field to tend.

She follows Zhao Jin out. Huan Chu watches her go, his expression for once uncertain.

title: The Useless Junior Sister Is Heaven's Chosen Daughter
description: A young outer disciple searching for a rare spiritual herb is betrayed and killed by a jealous senior sister, only to have her body taken over by a modern office worker from another world.
context:
Title: The Useless Junior Sister Is Heaven's Chosen Daughter
Description: A young outer disciple searching for a rare spiritual herb is betrayed and killed by a jealous senior sister, only to have her body taken over by a modern office worker from another world.

EXT. EXTREME COLD ILLUSION REALM - CAVE - DAY

FENG XI (20s, threadbare robes, frost in her hair) kneels before a luminous pink flower blooming from cracked ice. Her dirt-caked fingers tremble as she brushes the petals.

FENG XI
(barely a whisper)
One more task. Just this.

A WHITE SERPENT erupts from the frozen pool, scales scraping stone. Feng Xi doesn't scream—she rolls, grabs a sharp icicle, and drives it into the beast's eye as it strikes. Black vapor hisses from the wound. She collapses, clutching her ribs.

Feng Xi crawls back to the flower. Her fingers close around the stem.

SHEN ZHILAN (20s, immaculate white robes) appears at the cave entrance, already holding a cluster of identical blossoms.

SHEN ZHILAN
(mock pity)
All that effort for a weed.

FENG XI
(frozen)
Senior Sister... those are Ice Lilies. The Essence is—

SHEN ZHILAN
I know what it is. I also know you logged the coordinates in the sect ledger three days ago.

Feng Xi's face crumples—not with rage, but dawning betrayal.

FENG XI
(quietly)
You've been waiting.

SHEN ZHILAN
(smiling)
I let you clear the path. Consider it... a service to your betters.

FENG XI
(struggling up)
I'll report this. Master sees the truth in blood memory.

She pulls out a jade talisman. Shen Zhilan's smile flickers—panic, then something harder.

SHEN ZHILAN
(tossing the lilies)
Then remember this.
continuation:
The flowers arc through the air. As Feng Xi's eyes follow them, Shen Zhilan's sword flashes—not at her heart, but her wrist. The blade pins Feng Xin's sword-hand to the ice wall. The talisman falls.

FENG XI
(gasping)
My meridians...

SHEN ZHILAN
Now you can't hold a blade. Can't prove a thing.

She plucks the glowing Essence from Feng Xi's slack fingers.

SHEN ZHILAN
(softly)
You were supposed to stay in the outer sect where you belonged. Grateful. Invisible.

She turns to leave. Feng Xi spits blood onto the ice.

FENG XI
(whispered)
I was never invisible.

INT. MODERN OFFICE - CUBICLE - NIGHT

OFFICE WORKER (20s, hoodie, dead eyes) stares at the same scene on her laptop. She knows what's next.

OFFICE WORKER
(to the screen)
Don't say it. Don't you dare—

She slams the laptop shut. The blue standby light flares, reflecting in her glasses. It pulses once, twice—then floods the cubicle.

OFFICE WORKER
(tired, unsurprised)
Third time this month.

INT. EXTREME COLD ILLUSION REALM - CAVE - DAY

Feng Xi's eyes snap open—different eyes. She stares at her impaled hand, the blood, the robes. Her first breath is a laugh, bitter and familiar.

FENG XI/OFFICE WORKER
(quietly)
Chapter forty-seven. The one where the plot armor cracks.

She looks at the cave entrance where Shen Zhilan disappeared.

FENG XI/OFFICE WORKER
(to herself, determined)
Okay, Feng Xi. Let's see if we can rewrite this ending.

title: He Gave Me Starlight
description: A forbidden romance between Sang Muye and Shen Xingli unfolds, but their secret relationship is exposed when her grandfather discovers compromising photos.
context:
Title: He Gave Me Starlight
Description: A forbidden romance between Sang Muye and Shen Xingli unfolds, but their secret relationship is exposed when her grandfather discovers compromising photos.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

SANG MUYE, a bespectacled, refined man, and SHEN XINGLI, a beautiful woman in business attire, stand before a floor-to-ceiling window. The city sprawls below them like scattered starlight.

Their palms press against the glass, fingers interlocking with hesitant tenderness.

SANG MUYE
What are we doing?

SHEN XINGLI's fingers trace across SANG MUYE's lips, his Adam's apple, then grasp his tie.

SHEN XINGLI
What I've wanted since that broken telescope.

She pulls SANG MUYE closer. They embrace tightly, gazing deeply at each other, then kiss passionately.

SANG MUYE
(barely a whisper)
Your grandfather—

SHEN XINGLI
—will never know.

They kiss again, urgent and desperate.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - LATER

The bed is covered with rose petals. SANG MUYE presses SHEN XINGLI beneath him.

SANG MUYE
If he finds out—

SHEN XINGLI
Then at least I had this.

He leans down to kiss her.

INT. SHEN FAMILY MANSION - NIGHT

SHEN XINGLI tiptoes in through the front door, looking nervous.

SHEN XINGLI (V.O.)
Not tonight. Please, not tonight.

She carefully crosses the living room. The room is brightly lit. OLD MASTER SHEN, an elderly man with a stern expression, sits on the sofa with a manila envelope.

OLD MASTER SHEN
Your security detail reported an anomaly.

SHEN XINGLI's body stiffens. She stops in her tracks.

SHEN XINGLI
A business dinner ran late. I should have called.

She smiles and tries to slip away.

OLD MASTER SHEN
Shen Xingli. Did you think I wouldn't recognize his father's building?

He throws surveillance photos onto the coffee table.

OLD MASTER SHEN
Look at what you've done.

SHEN XINGLI hesitantly walks forward and picks up the photos. When she sees their silhouettes against the city lights—starlight trapped between them—her pupils dilate instantly, shock written all over her face. The photos show her and SANG MUYE kissing passionately in the apartment.

OLD MASTER SHEN
(softly, dangerously)
You've brought the son of my enemy into my house. Through my granddaughter.

title: Reborn and Running, My Awakening Makes My Ex-Husband Panic
description: A woman discovers the dark truth about her marriage and family, leading to a desperate act of revenge before her rebirth.
context:
Title: Reborn and Running, My Awakening Makes My Ex-Husband Panic
Description: A woman discovers the dark truth about her marriage and family, leading to a desperate act of revenge before her rebirth.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: 1990 - Town Courtyard

SU QINGRAN sits on the edge of the bed, folding her husband's shirts into perfect squares. Her movements are slow, methodical.

XIAO GUODONG adjusts his tie in the mirror. A thick envelope of cash rests beside him.

XIAO GUODONG
Time moves quickly. Xiao Jun's wedding is almost here. Qingran, I've made arrangements. We'll relocate to the east courtyard. This house will serve its proper purpose.

SU QINGRAN stops mid-fold.

SU QINGRAN
My father built this house.

XIAO GUODONG
(without turning)
Family shares everything. Possessions have no memory.

SU QINGRAN
Sixteen years ago, you brought Shen Yunfang and her son here. "Temporary," you said.

XIAO GUODONG
(turning to her)
Consider it practice. For the family we never had.

The barb lands. Su Qingran's fingers tighten on the fabric.

XIAO GUODONG (CONT'D)
The Shanghai shop will be sold. Mother agrees—the proceeds, combined with your father's compensation and your nephew's settlement, will purchase Xiao Jun's new home. A fresh start for everyone.

SU QINGRAN
That money is blood money.

XIAO GUODONG
Don't be dramatic. Blood washes off.

He exits. Su Qingran stares at the closed door.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

SU QINGRAN intercepts XIAO GUODONG before he reaches the front door.

SU QINGRAN
(low)
You swore on our wedding day you'd never touch it.

XIAO GUODONG
I swore to protect you. This is protection.

SU QINGRAN
My nephew died because—

XIAO GUODONG
(interrupting)
Your nephew died because he couldn't control his temper. Just as your father couldn't control his tongue. Some families are cursed, Qingran. Ours doesn't have to be.

SU QINGRAN
(quietly)
I am not cursed.

XIAO GUODONG
(looking at her stomach)
Some things we must accept. I've been generous.

He leaves. Su Qingran stands alone, her eyes finding the framed photograph on the wall—her father, confident and young.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Young SHEN YUNFANG and ZHANG GUILAN sit on wooden stools, shelling peas.

ZHANG GUILAN
She still doesn't know?

SHEN YUNFANG
Guodong is careful. She trusts him.

ZHANG GUILAN
Good. She owes you everything. If Guodong hadn't reported her father to the authorities—

SU QINGRAN watches through a crack in the door, her face draining of color.

ZHANG GUILAN (V.O.)
"—the whole family would have been sent down. She'd be dead or worse."

QUICK CUT: SU QINGRAN's hand covering her mouth, tears tracking silent paths.

ZHANG GUILAN (V.O.)
"The compensation was her father's guilt. And that nephew..."

QUICK CUT: A memory—Su Qingran's nephew, passionate and alive, arguing with Xiao Guodong.

ZHANG GUILAN (V.O.)
"...Guodong just pointed him toward trouble. Boys will be boys."

ZHANG GUILAN (V.O.)
Now Xiao Jun will have what he deserves. What we all deserve.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

SU QINGRAN kneels beside the gas tank, her hands steady as she opens the valve. The hiss is soft, insistent. She pours rice wine in a careful line across the floor, the liquid darkening the wood.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SHEN YUNFANG and ZHANG GUILAN walk toward the house, carrying groceries.

SHEN YUNFANG
(sniffing)
Do you smell that? Like the market near the distillery—

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

ZHANG GUILAN and SHEN YUNFANG enter, freezing as the fumes hit them.

ZHANG GUILAN
(shouting)
Have you lost your mind?

SU QINGRAN stands near the kitchen, a single match between her fingers.

SU QINGRAN
(calm)
I'm returning what was borrowed. With interest.

She strikes the match. It flares to life. She opens her hand.

The match falls.

BOOM!

Fire races across the floor, up the walls. ZHANG GUILAN and SHEN YUNFANG scream, stumbling backward. The photograph of Su Qingran's father faces the flames.

SU QINGRAN stands motionless at the center, the fire reflected in her clear, dry eyes.

title: Reigniting the Glorious Era
description: A weapons researcher dies with regret and is reborn to the early days of the nation, determined to prevent the tragedy that cost his beloved colleague her life.
context:
Title: Reigniting the Glorious Era
Description: A weapons researcher dies with regret and is reborn to the early days of the nation, determined to prevent the tragedy that cost his beloved colleague her life.

INT. MUNITIONS FACTORY - DAY

ON SCREEN: MUNITIONS FACTORY AUDITORIUM

LI LONG, a middle-aged man in a Zhongshan suit with a commanding presence, walks into a spacious factory workshop. Inside, a group of SOLDIERS in military uniforms and TECHNICIANS in civilian clothes stand in neat formation. A military truck loaded with rocket artillery and a large cannon are displayed nearby.

LI LONG
Comrades, you are all top students who have returned from studying abroad, especially proficient in weapons research. The weapon placed on my left, I'm sure you are all familiar with it. Our Soviet allies call it Katyusha.

CHEN HUAN, a young technical backbone, shows shock and disbelief in his eyes.

LI LONG
The higher-ups have issued orders for us at North Ordnance to make further improvements on the existing Type-63 artillery within one month.

CHEN HUAN (V.O.)
Type-63... North Ordnance... Wanning?

ZHAO WANNING, a young female researcher with double braids, gently pats CHEN HUAN on the shoulder.

ZHAO WANNING
Comrade Chen Huan.

CHEN HUAN is startled and turns to see ZHAO WANNING. He freezes.

ZHAO WANNING
What's wrong? Are you feeling unwell?

CHEN HUAN
(murmuring)
Wanning...
continuation:
INT. FIELD HOSPITAL - DAY (FLASHBACK)

The hospital corridor is chaotic, with wounded being carried in continuously. Young CHEN HUAN frantically grabs a NURSE.

CHEN HUAN
Excuse me, do you know where Zhao Wanning from the Independent Regiment is?

NURSE
I don't know.

CHEN HUAN searches frantically through the corridor and finally sees two SOLDIERS carrying a stretcher covered with a white cloth. He rushes over to stop them.

CHEN HUAN
Where is Zhao Wanning?

SOLDIER
(quietly)
Engineer Zhao was killed in an artillery strike. Direct hit.

CHEN HUAN
(trembling)
She's okay, right?

SOLDIER
(avoiding his eyes)
She's gone, comrade.

CHEN HUAN reaches out to lift the white cloth. He sees ZHAO WANNING'S face—peaceful beneath the dust and blood. He takes a step back, his legs giving way as he collapses.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. MUNITIONS FACTORY - DAY

CHEN HUAN snaps back to reality, looking at the living ZHAO WANNING before him, his eyes filled with pain. He grips the workbench to steady himself.

ZHAO WANNING
(concerned)
Chen Huan, talk to me.

CHEN HUAN
(softly)
Just... a nightmare. From before.

LI LONG
We cannot depend on foreign designs forever. We must forge our own sword!

CHEN HUAN (V.O.)
The Eagle Offensive begins in six months. Wanning will volunteer, and that Type-63 will fail—and she'll be gone. I've lived forty years of regret. Not again.

CHEN HUAN'S eyes change from confusion to determination.

CHEN HUAN
(loudly)
Yes! We Chinese must have our own Katyusha—but thirty days won't be enough. We need to start from the propellant up.

Everyone looks at him in surprise. CHEN HUAN steps forward, his gaze fixed on the weapon.

CHEN HUAN
We'll build it better than theirs.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Accidentally Pregnant with My Boss's Child
description: A woman discovers she is pregnant after a drunken night with a mysterious man, while helping her friend deal with her own pregnancy troubles.
context:
Title: Accidentally Pregnant with My Boss's Child
Description: A woman discovers she is pregnant after a drunken night with a mysterious man, while helping her friend deal with her own pregnancy troubles.

INT. SU XIA'S APARTMENT - DAY

SU XIA (28, weary but resilient) enters the cramped apartment, juggling grocery bags and exhaustion.

From her bedroom, YE LIN (26, sharp features masking desperation) emerges. Her eyes lock on the designer handbag dangling from Su Xia's wrist.

YE LIN
Su Xia.

Ye Lin intercepts her, snatching the bag with trembling hands. She examines it like a prosecutor with evidence.

YE LIN
(quietly fierce)
New scratches. Right across the clasp.

SU XIA
(confused)
I kept it wrapped the entire interview. It never left my sight--

YE LIN
(turning the bag)
Here. Here. And here. Do you know what this cost?

SU XIA
(softly)
I'll replace it. Once I land something.

YE LIN
The rent's already three weeks late.

Su Xia flinches. Ye Lin softens, a practiced shift.

YE LIN
(conciliatory)
But you're trying. That's what matters.

YE LIN (V.O.)
She'll never know I scratched it myself. The consignment shop needs pristine bags. We need groceries.

YE LIN's fingers brush SU XIA's neck, revealing a purple bruise beneath her collar. Ye Lin's breath catches.

YE LIN
What happened?

SU XIA
(covering it)
Networking event. Open bar. I don't... remember getting home.

FLASHBACK:

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT (MEMORY FRAGMENT)

SU XIA stumbles, vision swimming. A man's hands—strong, unfamiliar—steady her. She sees only a blurred face and a hint of ink on his wrist before darkness.

BACK TO:
continuation:
INT. SU XIA'S APARTMENT - DAY

SU XIA
I woke up alone. Clothes intact. Figured I just...

YE LIN
(quietly)
You were a virgin. Was it worth it?

YE LIN doubles over, hand flying to her mouth. She retches into the sink.

SU XIA
(rushing over)
Linlin!

YE LIN waves her off, spitting water. Her reflection in the faucet shows tears, not nausea.

SU XIA
How long?

YE LIN
Don't.

SU XIA
(eyes hardening)
The test in your trash. The prenatal vitamins. It's Li Kai's.

YE LIN
(defeated)
He blocked my number yesterday.

SU XIA grabs her phone. Ye Lin reaches for it—too slow.

INT. POOL HALL - DAY

LI KAI (30, casual cruelty) lines up a shot. His phone buzzes. He checks the screen, smirking.

LI KAI
(answering)
The charity case is calling me?

SU XIA (V.O.)
(fierce)
Li Kai. Ye Lin's pregnant. You disappeared.

LI KAI
(leaning against the table)
So? I'm not a doctor. I'm not her husband. What do you want, a medal for stating facts?

SU XIA (V.O.)
You promised--

LI KAI
I promised a good time. Not a lifetime. Tell her to handle it.

CLICK. He hangs up.

INT. SU XIA'S APARTMENT - DAY

The phone drops from SU XIA's hand.

YE LIN
(whispered fury)
You just made it worse. He thinks I'm pathetic.

SU XIA
He is pathetic.

YE LIN
And what are you? Meddling where you're not wanted. Maybe you just need me to be as miserable as you are.

YE LIN storms out, slamming the door. Su Xia stands frozen, the hickey burning like a brand.

EXT. CITY SKYLINE - DAY

AERIAL SHOT: The city sprawls beneath a hazy sky.

SUPER: Ten weeks later.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

SU XIA sits straighter now, worn blazer over a changed body. She grips her knees.

DOCTOR
(50s, professional)
Your hormone levels confirm it. Ten weeks.

SU XIA
But I haven't... I mean, I thought it was stress.

DOCTOR
It often is. Until it isn't. Have you considered your options?

SU XIA (V.O.)
Options. As if that night was a multiple-choice question I could erase.

FLASHBACK:

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT (MEMORY FRAGMENT)

SU XIA on her back, the MYSTERIOUS MAN above her. His glasses catch the light, obscuring his eyes. On his forearm, a flame tattoo licks toward his wrist. His lips brush her neck.

MYSTERIOUS MAN
(low)
Is this okay?

SU XIA
(dreamlike)
Mmm.

He kisses her throat, hard enough to mark.

BACK TO:

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

SU XIA's fingers trace the ghost of that bruise on her neck, now faded. Her other hand rests on the soft curve beneath her shirt.

SU XIA (V.O.)
The man with the flame tattoo. Who was he? And why do I feel like I've seen that tattoo before...
group_id: accidentally pregnant with my boss's child

title: Night in Fancy Dress
description: A young woman faces escalating abuse from her stepfather while her mother's denial deepens their desperate situation.
context:
Title: Night in Fancy Dress
Description: A young woman faces escalating abuse from her stepfather while her mother's denial deepens their desperate situation.

INT. TANG YU'S HOUSE/BEDROOM - NIGHT

Thunder and lightning rage outside.

TANG YU (female, about 20 years old) sleeps fitfully. The door opens silently—her stepfather TIAN DALEI (male, about 50 years old) enters, whiskey bottle in hand. He moves to the bedside and leans close.

Lightning flashes across his face. TANG YU wakes with a start.

TANG YU
(terrified)
Stepfather—don't—

TIAN DALEI
(low, slurred)
Don't fight me. I'm all that's keeping a roof over your head.

He lunges. TANG YU struggles. His hand finds the sheets—blood.

TIAN DALEI
(disgusted)
Filthy.

He wipes his hand on the blanket, turns back to her.

TIAN DALEI
(cold)
I'll wait.

He exits. TANG YU sits up, trembling. Her terror shifts to something harder—resolve.
continuation:
INT. TANG YU'S HOUSE/LIVING ROOM - DAY

The living room is in disarray, furniture overturned. TIAN DALEI is assaulting TANG YU's mother HAN MEI (female, about 40-something years old), tearing at her clothes.

TIAN DALEI
(roaring)
Where's the money?

He strikes HAN MEI. She falls. TANG YU hides behind the door, gripping the frame, tears streaming down her face.

TIAN DALEI
I need it now! Don't make me ask again!

HAN MEI
(crying out)
It's gone! Everything's gone!

TIAN DALEI searches her roughly, finds a wad of bills tucked in her waistband. He pockets it.

TIAN DALEI
(turning, sees Tang Yu)
How long?

TANG YU
(voice shaking)
Two days.

TIAN DALEI
(nods)
Lock your door.

He leaves. TANG YU rushes to HAN MEI.

TANG YU
(crying)
Mom—we have to go—

HAN MEI
(shoves her away)
And go where?

TANG YU
Anywhere—I've saved—

HAN MEI
(slaps her)
You think he'd let us leave? You think I can survive without him?

Han Mei's voice breaks. She won't look at her daughter.

HAN MEI
(whispering)
Just... make yourself scarce. Please.

TANG YU sits back, stunned. TIAN DALEI's words echo.

TIAN DALEI (V.O.)
I'll wait.

TANG YU's hand finds a piece of broken glass on the floor. She holds it up, watching the light. Her tears stop. She makes a choice.

title: Mother-in-Law's Card Game Saves the Day
description: A skilled card player mother-in-law wins at every table, but rushes to save her son-in-law when he's trapped in a gambling den after being set up.
context:
Title: Mother-in-Law's Card Game Saves the Day
Description: A skilled card player mother-in-law wins at every table, but rushes to save her son-in-law when he's trapped in a gambling den after being set up.

INT. COURTYARD MAHJONG TABLE - DAY

Four women huddle around a crowded mahjong table in a tight community courtyard. QIN LING (60s, sharp-eyed, nimble fingers) casually arranges her tiles. Three NEIGHBORS sweat nervously.

MALE CARD PLAYER
(leaning over Aunt Zhang's shoulder)
Hey, let me draw for you. Can't be worse than your luck.

AUNT ZHANG
(praying with hands together)
God of Wealth, just once. Let me break even before my husband notices.

CARD PLAYER A
(impatiently)
Play something. Anything.

QIN LING
(smiling faintly)
Last tile.

QIN LING reveals her hand with a quiet flourish.

QIN LING
Nine Gates. Pure and perfect.

CARD PLAYER B
(awestruck)
Twenty years... first time I've seen a Nine Gates in the wild.

AUNT ZHANG
(defeated)
That's six rounds straight. You should just empty my purse at the start.

MALE CARD PLAYER
(to others)
Told you. Never bet against Qin Ling.

QIN LING
(gathering cash with practiced ease)
Sun's getting low. My daughter's family is coming for dinner.

AUNT ZHANG
(grabbing her sleeve)
One more round. Double stakes.

QIN LING
(standing firmly)
When I'm good, I'm good. When I'm done, I'm done.

CARD PLAYER B
(to the table)
Wins and walks. Every. Single. Time.

INT. COURTYARD PAIGOW TABLE - DAY

QIN LING crosses the courtyard to a rougher table where four MEN play Pai Gow. They stiffen as she approaches.

CARD PLAYER C
(covering his tiles)
Sister Qin. We weren't expecting royalty.

CARD PLAYER D
(scrambling)
Go, go, deal her in.

CARD PLAYER C
(sighing)
I'm out. Folded before I started.

QIN LING
(sitting smoothly)
Don't be dramatic. One hand.

CARD PLAYER E
(resigned)
There goes my cigarette money for the month.

The DEALER slides tiles. QIN LING's fingers dance across them.

CARD PLAYER F
(confident)
Double nine cakes. Beat that, Sister Qin.

QIN LING
(laughing softly)
Let me see.

She reveals the Supreme Pair with a sharp snap.

CARD PLAYER C
(jumping back)
Supreme Pair?! We're playing for pennies!

CARD PLAYER E
(to the ceiling)
Why do I do this to myself?

QIN LING
(collecting the modest pot)
Gentlemen, it's been educational.

She stands, leaving them gaping.

CARD PLAYER F
That's it? One hand?

CARD PLAYER D
She's a phantom. A card shark phantom.
continuation:
INT. INDOOR CARD TABLE - DAY

QIN LING enters a smoky back room. XIAO LIU (20s, cocky) deals cards to three PLAYERS.

XIAO LIU
(slapping cards down)
Today I bankrupt you grandpas.

QIN LING
(leaning in the doorway)
Mind if I cut in, Xiao Liu?

XIAO LIU
(stuttering)
A-Aunt Qin. I meant, please, sit.

CARD PLAYER H
(awed)
You're everywhere.

CARD PLAYER I
(chuckling)
Like a tax collector.

QIN LING
(settling in)
Only for the careless.

She plays with surgical precision.

QIN LING
Bomb. Straight. Triple with kicker. Spring hand. Pay.

The table groans. She sweeps the money.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

QINGQING (30s, frantic) skids her bicycle into the courtyard, spots QIN LING emerging.

QINGQING
(gasping for breath)
Aunt Qin! Da Niu's in trouble. They dragged him to the—

QIN LING
(calm exterior cracking)
My son-in-law doesn't gamble.

QINGQING
Exactly! He refused, so they forced him. Said he owes "entertainment fees." Now he's down five thousand at Boss Zhou's den.

QIN LING
(eyes flashing)
Get me there. Now.

INT. GAMBLING DEN - DAY

Smoke hangs thick. DA NIU (40s, terrified) sits at a dice table. His shirt is soaked with sweat and spilled beer. A HEAVY (30s, scarred) looms behind him.

GAMBLERS
Big! Big! Big!

The dice settle. Wrong. DA NIU watches his last chips vanish.

DA NIU
(whispering)
It's gone. My daughter's tuition...

EXT. OUTSIDE GAMBLING DEN - DAY

QINGQING's bicycle screeches to a halt. A NEIGHBOR woman waits, twisted with worry.

FEMALE NEIGHBOR
Sister Qin, thank heaven. They're not letting him leave. Says he owes interest now.

QIN LING
(striding forward)
I brought interest.

She pulls a thick roll of cash from her pocket.

INT. GAMBLING DEN - CONTINUOUS

QIN LING bursts through the door, QINGQING behind her. The room goes silent.

QIN LING
(to the room)
My son-in-law's debt. I'll clear it.

BOSS ZHOU (50s, gold chains) emerges from shadows.

BOSS ZHOU
(smiling coldly)
A woman? How quaint. Double or nothing. Your money against his freedom.

QIN LING
(fierce smile)
One hand. My game.

She points to a pristine mahjong table in the corner.

QIN LING
Nine Gates. If I don't make it, you get everything. If I do, Da Niu walks.

The room holds its breath.
