title: My Best Friend Gave Me a Xiuhe Dress Before My Wedding
description: Before her wedding, Chen Jingyi receives a luxurious Chinese wedding dress from her best friend, but memories from her past life reveal a deadly betrayal.
context:
Title: My Best Friend Gave Me a Xiuhe Dress Before My Wedding
Description: Before her wedding, Chen Jingyi receives a luxurious Chinese wedding dress from her best friend, but memories from her past life reveal a deadly betrayal.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHEN JINGYI, wearing an elegant plain suit, stands in front of a full-length mirror.

YAO QINGQING enters carrying a gorgeous red Chinese Xiuhe wedding dress, accompanied by WANG YANZHE.

YAO QINGQING
Jingyi, for your wedding, I specially hired a designer for over a hundred thousand yuan to custom-make this Chinese Xiuhe dress for you.

CHEN JINGYI (V.O.)
Before my wedding, my best friend spent everything on this Xiuhe dress. But I remember—vividly, impossibly—how this gift once killed me.

YAO QINGQING
Try it on quickly and see if it fits.

CHEN JINGYI (V.O.)
Because in that life, this is how she deceived and framed me.

CHEN JINGYI takes the Xiuhe dress, her expression carefully neutral, but her knuckles whiten.

CHEN JINGYI
No, Qingqing, I can't accept this. You still need treatment. This is all your savings, isn't it?

YAO QINGQING
(fingers trembling against the silk)
Jingyi, I've been diagnosed with late-stage breast cancer. There's no cure. You're my best friend, and my last wish...

YAO QINGQING steps forward and hugs CHEN JINGYI with surprising force.

YAO QINGQING
(whispered)
Is to see you wear the Xiuhe dress I gave you and marry Yanzhe.

WANG YANZHE
(quietly)
Jingyi, accept it. That way Qingqing can have peace of mind.

CHEN JINGYI
(after a long beat)
Alright. I'll go try it on right now.

CHEN JINGYI takes the Xiuhe dress and leaves. YAO QINGQING and WANG YANZHE exchange a glance—relief flickering between them.
continuation:
Later, CHEN JINGYI comes down the stairs wearing the Xiuhe dress, looking radiant.

WANG YANZHE
(admiringly)
You look beautiful.

CHEN JINGYI smiles, then notices YAO QINGQING's collarbone—red and raw where she's scratched a mole until it bled.

CHEN JINGYI
Qingqing! Your wound—I'll get the first aid kit.

YAO QINGQING
(holds her back, nails sharp)
No need. I just saw how beautiful you looked and got overwhelmed. Jingyi, promise me you'll wear this Xiuhe dress and practice more over the next few days to make sure everything is perfect on your wedding day.

As she finishes speaking, CHEN JINGYI's breath hitches. She clutches her chest subtly, hiding the spasm.

CHEN JINGYI (V.O.)
The poison works faster than I remember.

She forces herself upright, meeting their eyes.

CHEN JINGYI
I'll hang it properly upstairs.

She exits calmly, leaving YAO QINGQING and WANG YANZHE staring after her.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

CHEN JINGYI lies in the hospital bed, conscious, a phone recording on the side table. WANG YANZHE enters with a DOCTOR.

WANG YANZHE
Are the results in?

DOCTOR
Yes. We've identified a fast-acting toxin absorbed through the skin. The fabric sample she brought in confirmed it.

CHEN JINGYI
(quietly)
Toxin.

She looks at her phone—recording still active. Then at the IV bag, deliberately placed away from her bed.

CHEN JINGYI (V.O.)
They couldn't wait. The same plan, the same dress. This time, I'm the one setting the trap.
group_id: my best friend gave me a xiuhe dress before my wedding

title: Rise of the Son-in-Law (Episode 35)
description: A son-in-law with a special constitution is discovered by a martial arts master, while his wife's family plans to force a divorce before a major sect competition.
context:
Title: Rise of the Son-in-Law (Episode 35)
Description: A son-in-law with a special constitution is discovered by a martial arts master, while his wife's family plans to force a divorce before a major sect competition.

EXT. NIGHT

Beneath ancient pine trees, moonlight filters through the canopy. The GRAND UNCLE MASTER, a wandering hermit with wild hair and tattered robes, squats on a fallen log, tearing into a roasted chicken with his fingers.

DISCIPLE
Grand Uncle Master, how does the chicken taste?

GRAND UNCLE MASTER
Mm, delicious. Very good, very good.

DISCIPLE
You've returned from your travels. Do you have any interesting stories to share with this disciple?

GRAND UNCLE MASTER
Stories? Heh. Ever heard of someone whose bones sing when the wind blows through them? The Innate Flawless Body?

DISCIPLE
You mean the legendary constitution where one day of practice equals ten years for others?

GRAND UNCLE MASTER
Hmph. You only know the bedtime story. The truth? Meridians flow backward. Acupoints shift like desert sands. Teach them standard forms, and you'll cripple them for life—make them less than common brawlers. But...

GRAND UNCLE MASTER
(pausing)
...find the right path, the one carved just for them, and they'll leave your so-called geniuses choking on dust. Half a month. That's all it would take to surpass every elder in your precious sect.

DISCIPLE
Then such a talent—please, Grand Uncle Master, bring him to us!

GRAND UNCLE MASTER
Alas. This old man arrived too late. Someone already filled the boy's head with garbage techniques, poisoned his foundation. To make him whole again, he'd have to unlearn everything. Forget every strike, every stance.

DISCIPLE
A tragedy.

GRAND UNCLE MASTER
Tragedy? Perhaps. Or perhaps the boy has his own ideas about being "whole." The time is near. Tonight at the third watch, I keep an appointment. The chicken, though—your salt merchant thanks you. Pay attention next time.

DISCIPLE
This disciple understands.

The Grand Uncle Master tosses the bone into the shadows, wipes his mouth on his sleeve, and melts into the forest.
continuation:
INT. SECT MAIN HALL - NIGHT

Polished jade pillars tower over polished marble floors. The disciple bows before Sect Leader ZHANG JINGHE, a man whose silk robes cannot hide his coiled ambition.

DISCIPLE
Sect Leader.

ZHANG JINGHE
The Supreme Elder never takes disciples. Now that he has the intention to pass on his legacy, we shouldn't let this opportunity go to outsiders. Why not hold a sect competition and select an excellent disciple for him?

DISCIPLE
(nods)

ZHANG JINGHE
I'll arrange it right away. Send invitations to the three great families. Make it known—the prize is not just apprenticeship, but access to the Scripture Pavilion's seventh floor.

INT. XIA FAMILY HALL - NIGHT

The hall drips with conspicuous wealth—gilded lanterns, ivory-inlaid screens, but the air itself feels cold. Calligraphy scrolls boasting "HARMONY" and "PROSPERITY" hang crooked on the walls.

The XIA FAMILY HEAD slams a sect notice onto the rosewood table, his laughter echoing off the expensive decor.

XIA FAMILY HEAD
(laughing loudly)

XIA DALONG
Father, this is wonderful news! In this Mingshan Sect competition, the first place winner will have the chance to become the Supreme Elder's disciple.

XIA ERLONG
Even if we don't take first place, if we get a good ranking, we'll have the chance to catch the eye of the elders, or even the Sect Leader.

XIA FAMILY HEAD
Exactly. This Mingshan Sect internal competition is a great opportunity for the Xia family to bring glory to our name.

XIA ERLONG
Then Third Brother's useless son-in-law must be dealt with before then. His presence is a stain.

XIA DALONG
Every day he remains, our family loses face. Our cousins in the Zhang clan already whisper.

XIA DALONG
(turning to the Xia Family Head)
Don't worry, I've already discussed this with Father.

XIA FAMILY HEAD
Father has his own plan.

XIA YAN and her son-in-law SUI JIN enter the hall. Sui Jin moves with a quiet economy, his threadbare robe a stark contrast to the family's finery. Xia Yan walks beside him, her hand unconsciously protective near his elbow.

XIA YAN
Father, you called for us so urgently. What's the matter?

SUI JIN
(cupping his fists)
Father-in-law.

XIA FAMILY HEAD
Sit down, both of you.

Sui Jin moves toward a sandalwood chair. XIA ERLONG suddenly darts forward, shoving him hard in the chest. Sui Jin catches himself against the wall, his knuckles white against the plaster, but says nothing. Xia Yan's hand flies to her mouth.

XIA ERLONG
You, a son-in-law, have no place to sit here. Go stand in the corner with the servants!

XIA YAN
(angrily)
Since when does the Xia family have such a rule?

XIA ERLONG
Since I decided our reputation matters more than your feelings. What, a useless live-in son-in-law wants to turn the tables and manage Xia family affairs?

XIA YAN
You're going too far! Father, control them!

XIA FAMILY HEAD
(sternly)
Enough. Erlong, Dalong, silence.

Xia Yan rushes to Sui Jin, steadying him with a hand on his shoulder. Her touch lingers, checking for injury.

XIA FAMILY HEAD
I called you back because the sect competition changes everything. Sui Jin.

SUI JIN
Father-in-law.

XIA FAMILY HEAD
Xia Yan.

XIA YAN
Father.

XIA FAMILY HEAD
I want the two of you to divorce immediately. The papers are prepared. Sign them, and a thousand spirit stones will compensate you for your trouble, Sui Jin. Consider it a... severance package.

Both XIA YAN and SUI JIN freeze. Sui Jin's gaze drops to the floor, not in submission, but as if seeing something no one else can. Xia Yan's face drains of color, her hand tightening on his arm.

title: Married Into Wealth, The Poor Girl Is Spoiled to Heaven (Episode 79)
description: A young woman wakes up in a hospital to discover she is pregnant with triplets after a fateful encounter with a mysterious man.
context:
Title: Married Into Wealth, The Poor Girl Is Spoiled to Heaven (Episode 79)
Description: A young woman wakes up in a hospital to discover she is pregnant with triplets after a fateful encounter with a mysterious man.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

WEN YOU lies in a hospital bed, slowly opens her eyes, and sits up.

A NURSE pushes the door open and enters with a clipboard.

NURSE
Morning. Your labs are back.

The NURSE hands WEN YOU an ultrasound photo.

NURSE
Three distinct heartbeats. Quite a surprise.

WEN YOU stares at the image, frozen.

NURSE
We need an emergency contact. Family? Partner?

WEN YOU suddenly crumples the photo, voice shaking.

WEN YOU
No!

WEN YOU
(pleading)
Please. No calls. My family will—

She cuts off, terror raw in her eyes.

TRANSITION: One month ago
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (FLASHBACK)

WEN YOU, wearing a green dress, walks through the hospital corridor, checking a room number on a scrap of paper.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

The ward is dimly lit. WEN YOU carefully pushes the door open and peeks inside.

WEN YOU
(softly)
Mom? Are you here?

WEN YOU enters the ward and closes the door. As she turns around, she collides with LU HUO CHEN, a man wearing glasses with a dazed look in his eyes. He steadies himself against the bedframe, breathing hard.

WEN YOU
(startled)
Wrong room. I'm sorry—

LU HUO CHEN's hand catches her arm, his grip firm but not cruel. His gaze is feverish, searching.

LU HUO CHEN
Tell me you weren't sent.

WEN YOU
(frightened)
I'm looking for my mother. Please let go.

LU HUO CHEN releases her with a bitter laugh, pressing his palm to his forehead. His tie hangs loose.

LU HUO CHEN
The board's final move. They'll have their scandal.

He sways. WEN YOU instinctively steadies him. Their eyes meet—his clouded with pain, hers with reluctant understanding.

LU HUO CHEN
(tugging at his tie)
Run. Now.

WEN YOU doesn't move. The moment stretches.

LU HUO CHEN
...or stay.

He leans in. She doesn't pull away.

CLOSE-UP: Their hands tightly clasped together on the bedsheet. Text appears on screen: "THREE HEARTBEATS BEGIN."

TRANSITION: TO BE CONTINUED
group_id: married into wealth, the poor girl is spoiled to heaven ()

title: The Lone Brave
description: A determined athlete faces discrimination and challenges as he strives to prove his worth against foreign competitors.
context:
Title: The Lone Brave
Description: A determined athlete faces discrimination and challenges as he strives to prove his worth against foreign competitors.

INT. STADIUM - DAY

A packed stadium roars as athletes line up. Flags wave—some Daxian, some foreign.

The crowd's chant builds rhythmically.

REFEREE
On your marks!

Close on LIU CHANGHE (23), muscles taut, eyes fixed on the finish line. There's something laser-focused, almost isolating, about his concentration.

The starting pistol cracks. Liu explodes forward, his form perfect.

AUDIENCE
(chanting)
Chang-he! Chang-he!

COMMENTATOR (V.O.)
And Liu Changhe surges ahead—but Meichuan is closing!

Liu lunges across the finish line—first, but barely. He immediately turns, searching the crowd, his "victory" face already collapsing into something more complicated.

EXT. TRAINING TRACK - DAY

THREE MONTHS EARLIER. The track is cracked concrete, weeds sprouting through.

Liu crosses an imaginary finish line, breathing hard. He checks his own stopwatch—disappointment flickers, then resolve.

His teammates watch from the sideline.

WU (O.S.)
Again?

Liu nods, already resetting.

TEAMMATE A (LIN, 22) holds a phone timer, tries to hide a wince.

LIN
(off the phone)
Ten point nine... uh, point nine eight.

Liu's jaw tightens. Not quite enough.

TEAMMATE B (WU, 24)
That's still faster than my morning commute.

WU tosses him a water bottle. Liu catches it without looking.

LIU CHANGHE
(quietly)
Joint Games qualifying is ten point eight five.

TEAMMATE C (MEI, 20)
You'll get there. You always do.

They share a look—less certainty than she's trying to project.

MEI
Besides, selection isn't just about times. Director Zhao—

WU
(cutting her off)
—has his own "selection process."

The air sours. Liu drinks, saying nothing.
continuation:
EXT. TRAINING TRACK - DAY

Same day. A polished sedan pulls up. DIRECTOR ZHAO (50s, always sweating) leads KAWASAKI (60s, sharp suit) and MEICHUAN (25, Olympic rings tattoo) across the track.

ZHAO
(to Kawasaki)
As you can see, we've made improvements since your last visit. New facilities in the annex.

KAWASAKI
(glancing at the cracked track)
Improvements? This is what Daxia calls progress?

Meichuan hangs back, studying Liu's team training with professional interest.

ZHAO
(nervous laugh)
We're still developing, yes. But our athletes show promise—

KAWASAKI
Promise doesn't win medals, Director. Our biomechanics lab offered you funding. You refused.

ZHAO
It was... politically sensitive. The Joint Games committee—

KAWASAKI
—prefers winners. Meichuan needs real competition, not...

He gestures at Liu's group, one finger circling the air.

KAWASAKI
...rehearsals.

Liu, within earshot, stops mid-stretch. His teammates freeze.

LIN
(quietly, to Liu)
Don't.

LIU CHANGHE
(stands, to Zhao—not Kawasaki)
Director, we're conducting timed trials today. If Meichuan-san needs competition...

He bows slightly to Meichuan, not Kawasaki.

LIU CHANGHE
...we would be honored.

Meichuan returns the bow, subtle but genuine. Kawasaki's smile doesn't reach his eyes.

KAWASAKI
(to Zhao)
How... quaint. A demonstration.

Zhao mops his forehead, trapped between factions.

ZHAO
(to Liu, voice low)
This isn't your concern, Changhe.

LIU CHANGHE
(meeting his gaze)
Then whose is it?

The question hangs. Not defiance—genuine confusion. Zhao has no answer.

title: A Lone Boat Carrying Dreams Across the Starry River
description: A woman disappears after a staged accident to escape her betrayers and returns transformed to dismantle those who wronged her.
context:
Title: A Lone Boat Carrying Dreams Across the Starry River
Description: A woman disappears after a staged accident to escape her betrayers and returns transformed to dismantle those who wronged her.

INT. MANSION CORRIDOR - NIGHT

A magnificent deep red door is slowly pushed open.

LI MENGYAO, wearing a black evening gown and cascading dark hair that conceals her features, moves with deliberate grace. Her posture alone commands attention.

She walks forward along a white marble corridor, where shadows pool between the recessed lighting.

LI MENGYAO (V.O.)
They buried a ghost six months ago. Tonight, the ghost collects debts.

INT. MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

A solemn memorial gathering. The centerpiece is a framed photograph—Li Mengyao's former self, tired and dowdy in an ill-fitting dress, her face blurred by movement.

A plaque reads: "In Memory of Li Mengyao, Devoted Mother."

XU LINGCHEN and a circle of associates in muted tones stand before it, their grief performative.

LI MENGYAO observes from a secluded balcony, her face partially obscured by a wide-brimmed hat.

LI MENGYAO (V.O.)
They held this ceremony before the fire even cooled. Now I'll show them how ghosts are made.

TRANSITION: One Year Ago
continuation:
EXT. STARLIGHT KINDERGARTEN - DAY

Sunny day. Parents gather at the gates, a tableau of modern perfection.

LI MENGYAO, exhausted in worn clothes, hair scraped back, clutches a homemade snack bag.

Children stream out. KEKE emerges, his eyes scanning past her.

LI MENGYAO
Keke! I made your favorite—

KEKE
(quietly, without looking at her)
The nanny's supposed to get me. You're embarrassing.

He drops the snack bag. It spills on the pavement. Li Mengyao's face crumples as other parents glance, then politely look away.

She checks her phone. A news notification glows: "Xu Lingchen: Tech Titan of Longdu Reveals Secret to Success—Family First."

She taps it. Xu Lingchen's interview plays.

XU LINGCHEN (ON SCREEN)
(real smile, eyes distant)
The woman who believed in me when I had nothing... she deserves everything.

LI MENGYAO
(whispering)
He still remembers. We started in a basement apartment.

Her phone buzzes with a text from XU LINGCHEN: "Emergency board meeting. Can't make Keke's recital. You understand."

She types: "Of course," then deletes it, replaces it with: "We'll celebrate after."

A shadow crosses her face.

EXT. MANSION GARDEN - DAY

Li Mengyao leads Keke through the side entrance, avoiding the main foyer. She spots unfamiliar silk scarves draped over the garden chair—a vibrant color she'd never wear.

INT. PRIVATE STUDY - DAY

LI MENGYAO places Keke's bag down. A muffled laugh echoes from the main bedroom above.

She pads upstairs, each step careful.

INT. MASTER BEDROOM DOORWAY - DAY

Through the cracked door: FANG YUNROU—not young, but sharp and tailored, her confidence like armor—sits on the edge of the bed fastening a Cartier watch. XU LINGCHEN hands her a glass of champagne.

FANG YUNROU
The board's impatient. They want a proper partner at these events, not a ghost from your past.

XU LINGCHEN
She raised me when I was nothing.

FANG YUNROU
(places hand on his chest)
And now I'll make you a dynasty. That's worth more than nostalgia.

LI MENGYAO's phone slips from her hand. It clatters on the hardwood.

Both heads turn toward the door.
group_id: a lone boat carrying dreams across the starry river

title: Child Waiting for Emergency Treatment While You Accompany Your First Love
description: A father discovers his wife is meeting her ex-boyfriend on their daughter's birthday, raising suspicions about their relationship.
context:
Title: Child Waiting for Emergency Treatment While You Accompany Your First Love
Description: A father discovers his wife is meeting her ex-boyfriend on their daughter's birthday, raising suspicions about their relationship.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

LELE lies on the floor coloring. Her hand trembles.

LIANG ZI walks into the living room.

LIANG ZI
Lele.

LELE looks up and tries to stand, wobbling slightly.

LELE
Daddy! You're home early.

LIANG ZI steadies her, his smile strained.

LIANG ZI
For your birthday? Always.

MOM walks over from the side, carrying a covered medicine tray.

MOM
Dinner's ready. I made the boiled shrimp.

INT. DINING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

LIANG ZI puts LELE in a chair and sits down. The table holds a birthday cake and a large platter of boiled shrimp arranged in a distinct pattern.

LIANG ZI
Lele, where's Mommy?

LELE
Mommy's not home.

LIANG ZI takes out his phone. A text from his wife: "Emergency at the clinic. Start without me."

LIANG ZI
Mommy had an emergency?

LELE
She said she's helping Uncle Zi Cong.

LIANG ZI
(quietly)
Uncle Zi Cong.
continuation:
MOM comes over carrying the shrimp.

MOM
Liang Zi, where's Xiao Lin? I made it the way she insisted—the special arrangement.

LIANG ZI looks at the shrimp, his expression darkening.

The door opens. XIAO LIN walks in, wearing a red dress and clutching a medical file.

MOM
Xiao Lin's back.

XIAO LIN
Mom, I'm not eating.

LIANG ZI stands.

LIANG ZI
Emergency at the clinic?

XIAO LIN
What?

LIANG ZI
With Zhao Zi Cong?

XIAO LIN's face pales.

XIAO LIN
You don't understand. He's back because—

LELE runs over and grabs XIAO LIN's hand, gasping for breath.

LELE
Mommy... I can't...

XIAO LIN drops the file. Papers scatter, revealing ZHAO ZI CONG's name on a medical chart.

XIAO LIN
Her medication—I left it in his car—

She turns to run out. LIANG ZI grabs her arm, his face stricken.

LIANG ZI
You left her medicine with him?

LELE slumps to the floor.

BLACKOUT.
group_id: child waiting for emergency treatment while you accompany your first love

title: Falling for My Younger Lover
description: A wealthy young man searches for the woman who helped him three years ago, only to find an unexpected connection that challenges their age difference.
context:
Title: Falling for My Younger Lover
Description: A wealthy young man searches for the woman who helped him three years ago, only to find an unexpected connection that challenges their age difference.

INT. HIGHWAY - DAY

Fast-paced music plays.

JIANG HANYU, wearing racing gear and a helmet, rides a heavy motorcycle speeding down the highway. He executes a perfect drift and stops.

He removes his helmet, revealing his handsome face. A faded scar near his left temple hints at a past he doesn't advertise.

Several black sedans arrive and stop. ASSISTANT LI and a group of BODYGUARDS exit, standing respectfully in a row.

BODYGUARDS (in unison)
Welcome home, sir!

JIANG HANYU
Assistant Li. Tell me you've found her.

ASSISTANT LI
Song Yan, Longchuan TV investigative journalist. Tonight at Hanting Bar. She's working undercover on the financial piece.

JIANG HANYU
Then I'll go find her now.

ASSISTANT LI
But the old lady has arranged a matchmaking banquet—

JIANG HANYU
—is every week. This is three years coming.

He pulls his helmet back on. The engine roars as he speeds away.

EXT. STREET - THREE YEARS AGO

Flashback to three years ago.

Rain drizzles on an empty side street. YOUNG JIANG HANYU, early twenties, soaked and shivering, sits on concrete steps with a cracked phone and empty wallet beside him. His expensive watch hangs loose on his wrist.

A PASSERBY glances at him.

PASSERBY
Could call someone. Family?

JIANG HANYU (looking up, defensive)
Phone's dead. And I don't have any family left to call.

The Passerby hurries away.

SONG YAN, mid-twenties, appears under a broken streetlamp with an umbrella and takeout container. She notices his watch, his posture—someone who had everything and lost it in a day.

SONG YAN
(sitting beside him)
Pork ramen from the place around the corner. Still hot.

She slips folded bills into his jacket pocket and wraps her scarf around his neck. It's striped blue and white.

SONG YAN
(not meeting his eyes)
Just pay it forward someday.

She stands to leave. He grabs her wrist instinctively.

JIANG HANYU
I don't even know your name.

SONG YAN
(turning back, smiling faintly)
The one who should have checked the weather report.

She touches his wet hair lightly, then disappears into the rain.

JIANG HANYU (V.O.)
The teardrop mole at the corner of her eye. How did I not notice?

He touches the scarf. It's still warm.

INT. HIGHWAY - DAY

Cut back to the present.

ASSISTANT LI
She's investigating money laundering at Hanting. Undercover. Be careful she doesn't mistake you for a story.

JIANG HANYU
Then I won't give her a story. I'll give her the truth.
continuation:
INT. BAR - NIGHT

Hanting Bar pulses with electronic music. SMOKE MACHINES obscure visibility.

SONG YAN, wearing a red slip dress that doesn't quite fit her style, sits at the bar with a club soda disguised as gin. A hidden camera pen clips to her clutch. She watches a group of suits in the VIP section.

SONG YAN (to herself)
Come on, Zhao. One incriminating conversation. That's all I need.

A hand reaches past her for a napkin. The wrist wears a vintage watch—familiar. She looks up.

JIANG HANYU, in a white silk shirt and black vest, meets her gaze. The scar on his temple. The confident posture. Nothing like the broken boy from the rain.

But the eyes are the same.

SONG YAN (V.O.)
Focus, Yan. Not another handsome distraction.

JIANG HANYU
Are you... waiting for someone?

SONG YAN
(sly smile)
Depends. Are you someone?

Later, in a dark corner booth. She shows him her press pass, hidden in her clutch.

SONG YAN
Promise you won't tell my editor I'm fraternizing with the target demographic.

JIANG HANYU
Your secret's safe with me.

He touches the corner of his eye instinctively. She notices the gesture, but can't place why it matters.

As they leave together, rain begins outside—just like three years ago. She shivers. He drapes his jacket over her shoulders.

The gesture stops her cold. She studies his face in the neon light. Recognition flickers.

SONG YAN
(quietly)
Have we...?

JIANG HANYU
(softly)
Not yet. But we could.

He leans in. She lets him. The kiss is soft, questioning. Not the transaction she expected.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - NIGHT

They stumble in, drenched from the run through rain. The desk clerk raises an eyebrow. Jiang slides a credit card across the marble.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT/MORNING

The room is modern, impersonal. Rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows.

On the bed, they pause. Her dress strap slides down her shoulder. His fingers trace it.

SONG YAN
(between kisses)
How old are you?

JIANG HANYU
Twenty.

She stills completely.

SONG YAN
Twenty.

(a beat)
God, when I graduated university, you were still in high school.

JIANG HANYU
Does it matter?

SONG YAN
It matters that I almost—

She pushes back, sitting up. The bedsheet falls. She's suddenly vulnerable.

SONG YAN
I have rules about this. About... everything.

JIANG HANYU
(sitting up too)
I know.

SONG YAN
(frowning)
How could you possibly—

JIANG HANYU
Because three years ago, you taught me that sometimes the people who save you don't even know they did.

He reaches for his discarded jacket, pulls out a folded, faded scarf. Blue and white stripes.

Her breath catches. She touches the corner of her eye.

SONG YAN
(whisper)
That was you. The boy in the rain.

JIANG HANYU
I'm not a boy anymore.

She looks at him—the man he's become.

SONG YAN
(stronger now)
Then prove it. Tell me your real name.

JIANG HANYU
Jiang Hanyu. I have a penthouse, a corporation, and a grandmother who wants to marry me off. But the only person I want...

He touches her cheek. The teardrop mole.

JIANG HANYU
...is the one who saw me when I was invisible.

A long beat. The rain stops outside.

SONG YAN
(standing, dressing)
Then you need to leave.

JIANG HANYU
What?

SONG YAN
Not because you're younger. Because I'm not some fantasy you built up. I'm messy. I'm a journalist who takes stupid risks. I don't do penthouses or grandmothers or...

She stops, fully dressed now. Picks up her hidden pen from the nightstand.

SONG YAN
...or men who might be the story I'm investigating.

JIANG HANYU
(realizing)
The money laundering.

SONG YAN
(sad smile)
See? You're quick. That's dangerous.

She heads for the door. He follows, still shirtless.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - MORNING

JIANG HANYU chases her, holding her shoes.

JIANG HANYU
Song Yan!

She stops. Turns.

JIANG HANYU
If I'm the story, investigate me. But don't run because you're scared I might be real.

He holds out her shoes.

She takes them slowly.

SONG YAN
Meet me tomorrow. Public place. You bring your financials, I'll bring my questions.

JIANG HANYU
Deal.

She walks away, but slower now. The shoes dangle from her fingers. He watches until she turns the corner, then touches the corner of his eye—where her teardrop mole would be.

The door clicks shut behind him.

title: Doomed, I'm Surrounded by Them (Episode 82)
description: Pan Xiaoxian, inheritor of ancient Chinese medical arts, must hide his identity for three years while working as a ride-share driver in Beijing, only to get entangled with a poisoned heiress.
context:
Title: Doomed, I'm Surrounded by Them (Episode 82)
Description: Pan Xiaoxian, inheritor of ancient Chinese medical arts, must hide his identity for three years while working as a ride-share driver in Beijing, only to get entangled with a poisoned heiress.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - NIGHT

A black sedan speeds along a winding mountain road.

ON SCREEN: PAN XIAOXIAN
ON SCREEN: INHERITOR OF ANCIENT CHINESE MEDICAL ARTS

PAN XIAOXIAN (V.O.)
My name is Pan Xiaoxian, inheritor of ancient Chinese medical arts. At eighteen, I descended from the mountain to heal the world with my medical skills.

INT. PAN XIAOXIAN'S CAR - NIGHT

PAN XIAOXIAN drives with quiet confidence, his face illuminated by passing streetlights. Brief, dreamlike images flash: golden needles, a corporate logo, a woman's silhouette.

PAN XIAOXIAN (V.O.)
Money, power, and the freedom to choose your own road.

PAN XIAOXIAN's expression shifts, the bravado fading into something more resigned.

PAN XIAOXIAN (V.O.)
Master's condition: three years in the mortal world, unable to reveal my identity.

PAN XIAOXIAN
(to camera)
So everything you just imagined? I have none of it.

The camera pulls back through the window to reveal the ordinary ride-share car navigating city streets.

PAN XIAOXIAN (V.O.)
To survive, I became a Beijing drifter.

PAN XIAOXIAN turns to the passenger with a weary but genuine smile.

PAN XIAOXIAN
Hello, passenger. I'm happy to serve you.

In the passenger seat, SONG YANRAN is crying, but her tears are silent, controlled. She clutches her purse like a shield.

PAN XIAOXIAN
Miss?

ON SCREEN: SONG YANRAN
ON SCREEN: HEIR TO SONG CORPORATION

SONG YANRAN
Can you drive faster?

PAN XIAOXIAN
Sure thing!

PAN XIAOXIAN (V.O.)
Four months in. Sometimes I forget who I was supposed to be.
continuation:
EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

LIN AODONG rushes out, his expensive suit disheveled, eyes scanning the street with predatory frustration.

ON SCREEN: LIN AODONG
ON SCREEN: SONG YANRAN'S FIANCÉ

LIN AODONG
That woman got away again!

INT. PAN XIAOXIAN'S CAR - NIGHT

The car moves through traffic. SONG YANRAN's controlled exterior cracks—she presses her fingers to her temples, a flush spreading across her neck.

SONG YANRAN
(moaning)
Mmm... so hot... I... I need...

She lunges forward, her hand landing on the steering wheel with surprising force.

PAN XIAOXIAN
What are you doing! Hey!

The car swerves sharply, stopping at the roadside, hazard lights blinking.

PAN XIAOXIAN
Are you trying to get us killed!

SONG YANRAN
Let go of me!

PAN XIAOXIAN notices her symptoms: the flushed skin, dilated pupils, labored breathing. He hesitates, then gently but firmly takes her wrist, feeling her pulse.

PAN XIAOXIAN
(to himself)
Hehuan Powder? But the synthesis requires...

SONG YANRAN
I need...

PAN XIAOXIAN
You've been poisoned. I can save you.

SONG YANRAN suddenly slaps PAN XIAOXIAN—not hard, but enough to shock. Then she grabs his face, her feverish eyes desperate.

PAN XIAOXIAN
What are you doing?

SONG YANRAN
Don't move.

SONG YANRAN kisses PAN XIAOXIAN. The screen goes black.

INT. PAN XIAOXIAN'S CAR - NIGHT

SONG YANRAN straightens her clothes and opens the car door. PAN XIAOXIAN slumps in the driver's seat, his face and collar covered with lipstick marks and a faint scratch.

SONG YANRAN takes out a stack of cash from her bag and throws it at PAN XIAOXIAN.

SONG YANRAN
I'm warning you, forget this ever happened.

SONG YANRAN gets out of the car, closes the door, and leaves.

PAN XIAOXIAN
(moaning in pain)
So what if you're rich? Don't let me see you again!

PAN XIAOXIAN sits up and sees money that fell on the ground. He glances after her retreating figure, conflicted.

PAN XIAOXIAN
Oh, there's more here.

He opens the car door and crouches down to pick up the money on the ground.

EXT. ROAD - NIGHT

PAN XIAOXIAN crouches in the middle of the road picking up money. A car speeds toward him, its blinding headlights shining on him.

PAN XIAOXIAN looks up, his expression terrified.

A flash of bright light crosses the screen.

title: Divorce at the Civil Affairs Bureau
description: A woman attempts to divorce her abusive, gambling husband but is stopped by her parents who care more about reputation than her safety.
context:
Title: Divorce at the Civil Affairs Bureau
Description: A woman attempts to divorce her abusive, gambling husband but is stopped by her parents who care more about reputation than her safety.

INT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - DAY

SHEN ANNING (30s, quiet strength) and SONG PEIYANG (40s, leashed menace) sit at the divorce counter. Two certificates await the stamp.

CLERK
Have you two thought this through? Are you sure you want a divorce?

SHEN ANNING
Yes.

The Clerk raises the stamp. It begins to descend—

ANNING'S FATHER and ANNING'S MOTHER rush in, breathless.

ANNING'S FATHER
(shouting)
Stop!

SHEN ANNING
(whisper)
No...

Anning's Father lunges, gripping her wrist.

ANNING'S FATHER
Ungrateful! Get up!

ANNING'S MOTHER
(to Anning)
The neighbors whisper. What will they say?

ANNING'S FATHER
Shame!

SONG PEIYANG watches, arms crossed, a small smile.

SHEN ANNING
(to her parents)
Your reputation. Over my life?

She yanks up her sleeve, revealing fresh bruises above yellowing ones.

SHEN ANNING
He beat me for hours last week. Gambled away our rent. I won't survive this.

ANNING'S MOTHER
(eyes downcast)
When you marry a chicken, you follow the chicken.

SONG PEIYANG steps forward, smooth.

SONG PEIYANG
Dad, Mom. I'm ashamed she troubled you. I've been stressed, but I love her—

ANNING'S FATHER
(to Anning)
No divorce. I will disown you.
continuation:
SHEN ANNING
Mom, please...

ANNING'S MOTHER
Behave.

She pulls her husband back.

SONG PEIYANG
(waving)
Dad, Mom, thanks.

He turns to Anning, dropping pretense.

SONG PEIYANG
I warned you.

SHEN ANNING
You called them.

SONG PEIYANG
Your phone. While you slept.

He extends his palm.

SONG PEIYANG
Salary. Now.

Anning stares at his hand. Then reaches into her purse—but pulls out her phone.

SHEN ANNING
Show me the text. Or I'll show them the photos. The hospital report.

Song's smile vanishes. The Clerk watches, alert.

CLERK
(quietly)
Madam, we have a safe room.

Anning's parents hover in the doorway, doubt on their faces.

ANNING'S MOTHER
Anning... photos?

SHEN ANNING
(to Clerk)
Please continue.

The stamp falls. Anning exhales.

SONG PEIYANG
(furious)
This isn't over—

SHEN ANNING
It is. I made copies.

She holds up a USB drive, walks out past her parents.

A bright light flashes—the Bureau's security camera.

Anning doesn't look back.

title: Finding the Secret of Cinderella
description: A reclusive fashion prodigy, scarred by public humiliation, becomes easy prey for her stepsister's long con—until a single interview exposes the true cost of her hunger for acceptance.
context:
Title: Finding the Secret of Cinderella
Description: A reclusive fashion prodigy, scarred by public humiliation, becomes easy prey for her stepsister's long con—until a single interview exposes the true cost of her hunger for acceptance.

EXT. FASHION GALA - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SCISSORHAND BAI stands before a shattered mannequin, scissors still in hand. The CROWD erupts.

CROWD
(laughing, chanting)
Scissorhands! Scissorhands!

SCISSORHAND BAI flees, dropping her shears.

EXT. TOWNHOUSE - DAY

SCISSORHAND BAI trudges home, clutching her portfolio.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Her stepsister BAI XUE arranges orchids.

BAI XUE
(not turning)
The gallery called again. I told them you were unwell.

SCISSORHAND BAI
You didn't have to—

BAI XUE
(facing her, concerned)
But who else will protect you?

She gestures to a cake—two tiers, sugar scissor motif.

BAI XUE
Your favorite. It took all morning.

SCISSORHAND BAI
(softening)
You shouldn't have.

BAI XUE
You deserve sweetness, sister. After all that ugliness.

SCISSORHAND BAI approaches the cake.

BAI XUE (V.O.)
(low, melodic)
Yes. Eat. Fill that hollow place.

BAI XUE
(aloud, bright)
The Gallery sketches—you promised them.

SCISSORHAND BAI
(mouth full)
Mmf. Desk drawer.

BAI XUE
My angel.
continuation:
INT. DESIGN STUDIO - DAY

SCISSORHAND BAI hunches over her drafting table. BAI XUE brings coffee, sees the laptop—an email from NEW FASHION.

BAI XUE
(reading aloud, casual)
'Dear Scissorhand Bai—intriguing portfolio... feature opportunity...'

BAI XUE
(turning to SCISSORHAND BAI, delighted)
They want you! You must go.

SCISSORHAND BAI
I can't—

BAI XUE
You won't have to. I'll be your voice.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE VENUE - DAY

REPORTERS crowd around. SCISSORHAND BAI, ill-fitting gown. BAI XUE, custom couture.

REPORTER
Which of you is—

BAI XUE
(smiling for cameras)
I'm Scissorhand Bai. This is my assistant... also Bai. Family tradition.

BAI XUE squeezes SCISSORHAND BAI'S shoulder—possessive, final. SCISSORHAND BAI stares at the cameras, hollow.

SCISSORHAND BAI
(whisper)
My shears...

BAI XUE
(whisper back)
Don't worry. I'll cut for you now.

SCISSORHAND BAI watches her sister become her. The cake turns to acid in her stomach.

title: Bringing the Human Trafficker to Justice
description: A young waitress discovers her childhood abductor on the news and must confront her painful past.
context:
Title: Bringing the Human Trafficker to Justice
Description: A young waitress discovers her childhood abductor on the news and must confront her painful past.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

Young waitress TAO GUIJIA, wearing an apron, carries a plate of steamed buns and a bowl of porridge, walking out from the kitchen with a practiced smile.

TAO GUIJIA
Your order is ready.

She places the food in front of a table of customers.

CUSTOMER (O.S.)
Check, please!

TAO GUIJIA
Coming.

TAO turns toward the cashier. Her hand drifts to her pocket, touching something small. She winces slightly, rubbing her lower back.

MALE CUSTOMER
Waitress—beer.

TAO GUIJIA
(quickly composing herself)
Right away.

TAO moves toward the cooler. Her phone VIBRATES. Caller ID: "Mom." The smile drops. She stares at it, then answers.

INT. RESTAURANT BY THE WINDOW - DAY

TAO stands by the window, phone pressed to her ear, gaze distant.

TAO'S MOTHER (V.O.)
Your brother's school fees are due. Why is it only two thousand this month? The doctor again?

TAO
(faintly)
It got worse.

TAO'S MOTHER (V.O.)
Then stop wasting money on doctors. Send everything next time. Your brother needs—

The call cuts. TAO lowers the phone, her fingers shaking. She swallows hard, eyes glassy. Her hand returns to her pocket, clutching something hidden there.

TAO (V.O.)
Five hundred yuan. Just to hear there's nothing they can do.
continuation:
INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

The OWNER appears, his voice sharp but controlled.

OWNER
Table four's been waiting. You're here to work, not stare out windows, understood?

TAO GUIJIA
(quickly wiping her eyes)
Yes, boss. Sorry.

OWNER
Get back to it.

TAO hurries toward the tables.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

TAO approaches a MALE CUSTOMER and FEMALE CUSTOMER with a bottle of beer. A TV on the wall plays the evening news.

TV NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...in the case against human trafficking suspect MEI, prosecutors presented surveillance footage showing...

MALE CUSTOMER
(glancing at his phone)
They caught her because of some traffic camera. Eight years.

TV NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...sentenced to eight years imprisonment.

TAO freezes mid-step. The glass bottle slips in her grip.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Should've been longer. They say she's appealing.

MALE CUSTOMER
They all do.

TAO sets the beer down with forced steadiness.

TAO GUIJIA
Your beer.

She turns. The TV screen shows a courthouse photo of MEI, 50s, unremarkable. TAO's breath catches. She stares, unblinking. Her hand drifts to her pocket again, emerging with a broken green plastic ring—child-sized, faded.

FLASHBACK - EXT. FOREST PATH - 20 YEARS AGO

Desaturated footage.

MEI (30s) drags a small figure by the wrist through dense trees. YOUNG TAO (6) stumbles, her green ring catching light.

YOUNG TAO
(whispered, terrified)
Please... I dropped my ring...

MEI
Keep walking.

Young Tao looks back at something glinting in the dirt. Mei yanks her forward. The ring is left behind, half-buried.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

TAO stands motionless, tears streaming down her face. She turns the broken ring over in her fingers, fitting the pieces together. Her jaw tightens.

TAO (V.O.)
You left something behind.

TAO pulls out her phone with her free hand. Her thumb hovers over the emergency number on the screen, her gaze fixed on the TV.
group_id: bringing the human trafficker to justice

title: The Little Ancestor Became Obedient
description: A young woman is reborn to the day she was framed for drugging her fiancé, determined to change her fate and make those who wronged her pay.
context:
Title: The Little Ancestor Became Obedient
Description: A young woman is reborn to the day she was framed for drugging her fiancé, determined to change her fate and make those who wronged her pay.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Inside the hotel

LU ZHIXIA (the Gu family's adopted daughter) lies on the bed, eyes closed. SHEN CI (Lu Zhixia's fiancé) leans over her, his expression pained, breathing ragged.

SHEN CI
Zhixia... I think I've been drugged. My head...

His hand reaches for her face. LU ZHIXIA's eyes snap open—wide with sudden, horrifying recognition. Her body goes rigid.

LU ZHIXIA (V.O.)
This moment. This exact moment.

She lunges for a red decorative box on the nightstand. SHEN CI grabs her wrist.

SHEN CI
Don't fight it. We belong together--

LU ZHIXIA
(struggling)
Let go!

She wrenches free, swings the box with desperate force. It connects with his temple. SHEN CI collapses, groaning.

Panting, LU ZHIXIA staggers to her feet. She stares at him with pure loathing.

LU ZHIXIA (V.O.)
Not this time.

She straightens her clothes, smooths her hair, and walks out with measured steps.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

LU ZHIXIA exits just as GU CIYUAN (President of Gu Corporation) turns the corner ahead, flanked by BODYGUARDS. His secretary LINA holds a tablet. MENG WAN'ER trails behind, phone in hand, eyes widening.

GU CIYUAN
Stop her.

The guards move forward. LU ZHIXIA freezes.

GU CIYUAN
(to Lina, low)
The tip was accurate. Get the security footage.

MENG WAN'ER
(stepping forward, voice saccharine)
Zhixia, I tried to stop you. Drugging Shen Ci like this—it'll destroy the Gu family's reputation.

From inside the room, SHEN CI's slurred voice:

SHEN CI (O.S.)
No... she didn't... we were just...

LINA
Sir, he's conscious. Should we call medical?

GU CIYUAN
(eyes on Lu Zhixia, cold)
Arrest him. Possession of controlled substances.

GU CIYUAN takes a step closer to LU ZHIXIA, his voice dropping.

GU CIYUAN
Tell me I was wrong about you.

LU ZHIXIA meets his gaze. Her hands tremble. She blinks—once, twice—tears welling despite her control.

INT. OUTDOORS - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

ON SCREEN: The Previous Life

GU CIYUAN holds a younger LU ZHIXIA in his arms. Rain pours down. Her face is pale, blood on her lips.

GU CIYUAN (V.O.)
I found you too late. Always too late.

INT. CAR - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

GU CIYUAN (V.O.)
If I'd been braver... would you have chosen me?

A hand goes limp. The car fills with engine exhaust.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - PRESENT

GU CIYUAN
Lu Zhixia. Do you have anything to say?

LU ZHIXIA looks up at him, tears streaming down her face. She walks toward him, each step deliberate. The bodyguards shift uncertainly. MENG WAN'ER inhales sharply.

LU ZHIXIA stops before GU CIYUAN. She looks up at him—seeing him, truly seeing him, for the first time in both lives.

Under everyone's astonished gaze, LU ZHIXIA stands on her toes and kisses GU CIYUAN.

title: Young Zhang Bei (Episode 63)
description: A young prodigy of the Zhang family demonstrates his appraisal skills as a Japanese master arrives to challenge the Eight Great Families.
context:
Title: Young Zhang Bei (Episode 63)
Description: A young prodigy of the Zhang family demonstrates his appraisal skills as a Japanese master arrives to challenge the Eight Great Families.

EXT. ANCIENT TOWN - DAY

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
Word spreads: Hikawa Daiyuu, master appraiser from across the sea, has returned to Great Xia with a declaration to test the Eight Great Families. Yesterday, he swept three houses in a single day, leaving none unbested.

QI ZHENGYANG walks along the streets, his calloused fingers twitching with quiet fury.

QI ZHENGYANG
This foreign thief's ambition grows bolder with every step on our soil.

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
This very morning, Hikawa Daiyuu and his disciples entered Suzhou. Whispers say the Zhang family stands next in his path.

QI ZHENGYANG arrives at a courtyard where a growing crowd watches a lean young man at an antique-laden table.

ZHANG BEI threads a silk cord through two seals, pulling it taut. The seals dance—spinning, stopping, reversing—in a blur of controlled motion.

ONLOOKER A
Dragon Rope Circling Treasure... he's actually doing it.

ONLOOKER B
My grandfather spoke of this technique. Thought it was a legend.

ONLOOKER C
Can a child truly master what masters spend decades learning?

Qi Zhengyang's eyes narrow. This is a test.

QI ZHENGYANG
(calling out)
Han Dynasty goldsmiths left their copper hollow!

ZHANG BEI
(without looking up)
Hollow from trapped air during casting. Genuine seals should feel light above, heavy below.

The spinning seal trembles—ever so slightly—then rights itself. Zhang Bei smiles.

ZHANG BEI
This one spins too true. The forger made it solid.

He flicks his wrist. The seal arcs down and shatters against the table.

ONLOOKER D
Stone dust! It was only pressed clay!

ONLOOKER E
The boy saw through it mid-spin...

ONLOOKER A
Zhang family's legacy is safe.

ONLOOKER B
continuation:
(quieter, to his companion)
But at what cost? He hasn't slept in two days.

Qi Zhengyang steps forward, presenting an ebony box.

QI ZHENGYANG
For your art. Imperial-grade pearl powder—rare as dragon's breath.

ZHANG BEI
For my mother's brushes. She'll need another.

QI ZHENGYANG
(startled, then understanding)
You're preparing for a siege. Hikawa comes tomorrow.

ZHANG BEI
(softly)
She'll paint whether I win or lose. I'd rather she paints joy.

Qi Zhengyang produces a small silk pouch.

QI ZHENGYANG
Three-hundred-year-old saffron. For tea. For strength.

Zhang Bei leans close.

ZHANG BEI
(whispering)
Both seals were false. I broke the cheaper one to keep the crowd calm.

QI ZHENGYANG
(stunned)
The genuine danger hides in plain sight?

ZHANG BEI
(laughing, suddenly a boy again)
You need sharper eyes, old friend!

He sprints toward the alley, youthful energy restored. Qi Zhengyang stares at the remaining seal.

A distant GONG echoes—three sharp notes from the Zhang family compound.

SERVANT'S VOICE (V.O.)
Young Master! The Elder Council summons you! Now!

ZHANG BEI
(calling back)
Tell them I'm coming! And tell Mother the pearl powder is real!

He vanishes into the twisting lanes. Qi Zhengyang watches the retreating figure, his shock melting into something like hope.

QI ZHENGYANG
(to himself)
With this young general defending the Zhang family... Hikawa Daiyuu will find his iron plate. Heh heh heh...

He pockets the seal with a faint smile.

title: The Abandoned Girl
description: A young girl is left behind when her parents divorce, each refusing to take responsibility for her.
context:
Title: The Abandoned Girl
Description: A young girl is left behind when her parents divorce, each refusing to take responsibility for her.

INT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - DAY

A young girl, SHEN WANQIU, wears a yellow floral shirt and stands alone, her expression carefully blank.

CLOSE-UP - A divorce certificate being stamped with "DIVORCED BY MUTUAL CONSENT."

CLERK (V.O.)
Your marriage is now terminated.

Shen Wanqiu's father, ZHAO JINBAO, and mother, GAO YUE, turn from the counter. Both glance at Wanqiu, then look away, pained.

SHEN WANQIU
(following)
Dad, Mom... can't we go home together?

GAO YUE
(quietly firm)
I can't breathe in that house anymore. You follow him.

ZHAO JINBAO
(defensive)
You wanted this. You take her.

GAO YUE
(angrily)
You never once went to her appointments!

ZHAO JINBAO
(sharp)
And you never missed a chance to remind me what she cost us!

They lock eyes—mutual resentment and guilt. Then they turn and walk in opposite directions, leaving SHEN WANQIU rooted in place.
continuation:
EXT. PARKING LOT - NIGHT

ZHAO JINBAO gets into a black sedan. Through the window, he looks back once. Then he drives away.

GAO YUE stands alone, trembling. She throws her purse down.

Suddenly, thunder crashes and heavy rain pours down.

SHEN WANQIU runs to GAO YUE and tugs her coat.

SHEN WANQIU
Mom, I'm scared.

GAO YUE turns. For a moment, her face softens. She hums a lullaby.

SHEN WANQIU
(confused)
Mom... I can't hear it. Not in my right ear.

The humming stops. GAO YUE's expression hardens—not with cruelty, but with a kind of breaking.

GAO YUE
(whispered)
Neither of us knows how to do this.

She walks to her white sedan. SHEN WANQIU follows.

SHEN WANQIU
Mom?

GAO YUE gets in and locks the doors. SHEN WANQIU runs to the window, pressing her palm to the glass.

SHEN WANQIU
(pleading)
Mom, please. I'll be good.

Inside, GAO YUE looks at the small hand. Her own hand mirrors it, stopping halfway. Her voice is flat.

GAO YUE
He left first. Why should I be the one to stay?

The car pulls away. SHEN WANQIU runs after it, slips, and falls into a puddle.

FLASHBACK AND VOICEOVER

SHEN WANQIU in slow motion. Underneath, fragmented memory:

ZHAO JINBAO (V.O.)
—another specialist bill I can't pay—

GAO YUE (V.O.)
—you missed the diagnosis again—

ZHAO JINBAO (V.O.)
—not my fault she was born this way—

GAO YUE (V.O.)
—she's eight years old, Jinbao—

ZHAO JINBAO (V.O.)
—some kids are just behind—

BACK TO REALITY

SHEN WANQIU lies in the downpour, soaked through. She curls into herself and hums the lullaby.

SHEN WANQIU
(quietly)
Don't abandon me... don't abandon me...

The rain intensifies. The humming continues, barely audible beneath the thunder.

title: Return to the Homeland
description: A top scientist decides to go abroad to advance his research on controlled nuclear fusion, facing accusations of betrayal while believing he serves his country's greater interests.
context:
Title: Return to the Homeland
Description: A top scientist decides to go abroad to advance his research on controlled nuclear fusion, facing accusations of betrayal while believing he serves his country's greater interests.

EXT. DESERT RESEARCH BASE - DAY

In the vast desert stands a research base composed of prefabricated buildings, sandblasted and worn. Scavenged equipment parts lie beside a rusted perimeter fence. A faded DAXIA NATIONAL FLAG flaps tiredly in the hot wind.

INT. EXPERIMENT CONTROL ROOM - DAY

Red alarm lights flash. Scientists in white protective suits work frantically. A whiteboard in the corner shows 343 red X's - failed experiments.

Gu Sen (30s, intense, exhausted) watches the reactor through protective glass. His hands tremble slightly.

A scientist pulls down a massive circuit breaker with force.

The entire control room shakes violently. Equipment emits smoke. Scientists stumble.

Silence, except for the HISS of cooling systems shutting down.

Gu Sen stares at the dead reactor. His knuckles are white on the console.

GU SEN
(quietly)
The containment field collapsed at fourteen seconds.

PROFESSOR JIN (60s, fatherly, weary) removes his protective goggles. His face is etched with decades of disappointment.

PROFESSOR JIN
The power couplings failed again. Same as last month.

Gu Sen picks up a melted component from the floor.

GU SEN
Moguo solved this two years ago. Their alloy specifications are classified.

Wang Youde (40s, pragmatic, protective) steps forward, his boots crunching on glass.

WANG YOUDE
Emols University invited you. I saw the letter.

SENIOR BROTHER (Late 30s, loyal, anxious) glances between them.

SENIOR BROTHER
Joint research program. With tech sharing. But...

WANG YOUDE
But it's a trap. You go, you'll be their poster boy. "Defecting Daxian genius." I've seen it before.

PROFESSOR JIN
Gu Sen, your work is here. With us.

Gu Sen looks at the whiteboard. At the 343 failures.

GU SEN
My work is nuclear fusion. Not geography.

SENIOR BROTHER
(pleading)
Junior Brother, they'll call you a traitor. Your parents...

GU SEN
My parents survived the Energy Crisis of '28. They know what happens when Daxia falls behind.

Wang Youde slams his hand on a table.

WANG YOUDE
And when you come back with nothing? When they keep the real tech for themselves? You'll just be another dog who bit his own tail.

PROFESSOR JIN
That's enough!

The room falls silent.

PROFESSOR JIN
(thoughtfully, to himself)
continuation:
Forty years ago, I watched our first reactor fail. Same desert. Same excuses. "Make do." "Be patient." We lost a generation to those words.

He turns to Gu Sen, eyes sharp.

PROFESSOR JIN
What if they don't let you publish? What if you disappear into a Moguo lab for ten years?

GU SEN
Then I'll send every note, every failure, every hypothesis back to you. Through the private channels. Through the diplomatic pouch. Through any means.

Professor Jin pulls out an old notebook from his coat. Its pages are yellowed.

PROFESSOR JIN
I kept this from my own time abroad. Before the blockade tightened. The last viable exchange we had with Moguo.

He holds it out to Gu Sen.

PROFESSOR JIN
If I sponsor your appointment... if I accompany you as a visiting scholar... we retain Daxian oversight. Officially.

Gu Sen stares at him.

GU SEN
Professor, your reputation...

PROFESSOR JIN
My reputation is an old man's vanity. Your future is Daxia's future.

Wang Youde turns away, his jaw tight.

SENIOR BROTHER
Professor... you're risking everything.

PROFESSOR JIN
We already have.

(he looks around the broken room)
We risk everything every day we refuse to change.

Gu Sen takes the notebook. Their hands meet.

GU SEN
(softly)
Thank you.

Professor Jin squeezes his hand, then releases.

PROFESSOR JIN
The War God Hall will review this. They'll want assurances. Plausible deniability.

WANG YOUDE
(coldly)
They'll want a scapegoat if it fails.

PROFESSOR JIN
Then let me be the scapegoat. Gu Sen carries enough.

Gu Sen starts to protest. Professor Jin stops him with a look.

PROFESSOR JIN
Go home. Tell your parents you'll be teaching. Nothing more.

Gu Sen nods, clutching the notebook. He turns toward the door.

Wang Youde watches him go, his expression unreadable. He pulls out his phone, scrolls through headlines: "ANOTHER DAXIAN SCIENTIST MISSING ABROAD."

SENIOR BROTHER
(quietly)
What if he's right?

Wang Youde doesn't answer. He just pockets the phone.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCRIPT

title: Homecoming
description: After seven years building an empire in Africa, Li Xu returns to Yun City as one of the continent's most successful entrepreneurs, ready to repay his debts and confront the family he left behind.
context:
Title: Homecoming
Description: After seven years building an empire in Africa, Li Xu returns to Yun City as one of the continent's most successful entrepreneurs, ready to repay his debts and confront the family he left behind.

EXT. CITY BOULEVARD - DAY

A convoy of black luxury sedans glides through morning traffic. The vehicles move with precision, commanding the road.

The lead car turns toward a gleaming convention center.

EXT. CONVENTION CENTER PLAZA - DAY

MAYOR OF YUN CITY waits with local OFFICIALS and BUSINESS LEADERS. Bodyguards flank the reception line. The atmosphere is taut with expectation.

MAYOR OF YUN CITY
(to an aide, low)
This investment is everything. No mistakes today.

The convoy enters the plaza. Sunlight flashes off tinted windows.

Inside the car, LI XU touches a simple steel watch against his expensive cuff.

A YOUNG BYSTANDER films from the crowd's edge.

The cars stop. Bodyguards exit first. One opens Li Xu's door.

Li Xu emerges. Beige suit, sunglasses. He surveys the waiting officials like a stranger in his own hometown.

A WOMAN approaches with flowers.

MAYOR OF YUN CITY
(beaming)
Mr. Li! Yun City welcomes you. We've prepared a conference—

LI XU
(removes sunglasses)
Seven years.
(beat)
Before conferences, I see my mother. And my daughter.

The mayor's smile falters. He wasn't briefed on a child.

FLASHBACK
continuation:
EXT. OLD TRAIN PLATFORM - DAY

The image dissolves into memory.

YOUNG LI XU kneels on cracked concrete, travel bag beside him. His mother ZHANG GUIFANG holds a sleeping toddler—LI MEI. Uncle LI GUANGZU stands apart, arms crossed. Cousin LI XING hovers.

YOUNG LI XU
(to Li Guangzu)
Uncle. Please. Take care of them.

LI GUANGZU
Africa?
(snorts)
Send what you can. Don't dream too big.

YOUNG LI XU
(to his mother, voice breaking)
Mom... I'll make this right.

ZHANG GUIFANG
(holding back tears)
Just make it back.

Li Xu kisses his daughter's forehead. She stirs, reaches a small hand toward his face.

LI XING
Keep the phone charged, brother.

YOUNG LI XU
(stands)
I'll make you proud.

He walks toward the train. Doesn't look back.

END FLASHBACK

EXT. CONVENTION CENTER PLAZA - DAY

Li Xu stands motionless. The flowers remain unaccepted.

LI XU
(to Mayor)
The old district. Now.

Li Xu's hand tightens on the worn strap of his bag—the same simple bag, now leather-patched but intact.

His expression reveals nothing. But his knuckles are white with the weight of seven years.

title: The Matriarch Seeks Divorce (Episode 81)
description: A matriarch faces challenges from her husband's family as she prepares for his return home.
context:
Title: The Matriarch Seeks Divorce (Episode 81)
Description: A matriarch faces challenges from her husband's family as she prepares for his return home.

INT. MARQUIS MANOR MAIN HALL - DAY

CHU WANQING walks briskly into the main hall, her confident stride checking slightly when she sees Zhang Shi already at Grandmother's ear.

CHU WANQING
Grandmother, I heard my husband is coming back.

ZHANG SHI stands beside GRANDMOTHER, looking displeased.

ZHANG SHI
(coldly)
The Marquis is coming back. Here is the list. Look it over carefully and make the necessary arrangements to welcome the Marquis home.

LINGDANG steps forward to receive the list.

LINGDANG
(checking the list, surprised)
Replace the tiles and doors? We just replaced them during New Year's, and it hasn't even been half a year. And this menu, even a state banquet wouldn't be this extravagant.

ZHANG SHI
(suddenly steps forward and slaps LINGDANG)
Lowly dog!

LINGDANG
(covering her face, shocked--but her jaw sets)

ZHANG SHI
(sternly)
Is it your place to speak here?

GRANDMOTHER
(calmly)
Wanqing, this maid from your family home is far too insolent.
continuation:
ZHANG SHI
If she doesn't know her place, it doesn't matter. Just sell her off and replace her with someone who does.

CHU WANQING
(frozen for a breath, her voice tight)
Grandmother. Lingdang knows she was wrong.

CHU WANQING
(to LINGDANG)
Lingdang, apologize.

ZHANG SHI
Kneel down!

LINGDANG reluctantly kneels, her posture stiff with suppressed fury.

GRANDMOTHER
I won't hold it against an insolent maid. I'll just ask you this: should this money be spent or not?

CHU WANQING
(hesitating briefly, then--a faint, mirthless smile)
It should. A Marquis deserves a home that reflects his station.

GRANDMOTHER
Good that you know. Go make the preparations.

CHU WANQING
Yes.

CHU WANQING leaves with LINGDANG.

ZHANG SHI
(supporting GRANDMOTHER)
Truly, the master is reflected in the servant. A mere slave dares to talk back to the Grand Madam. She must have been influenced by Lady Chu. Merchant families are just so vulgar. You can't make silk from a sow's ear.

GRANDMOTHER
(cold smile)
No need to be anxious. Even if mud can't stick to the wall, it doesn't matter. Our Marquis Manor will soon welcome a true lady of noble birth. When that happens, she'll be more anxious than anyone.

title: Movie Queen, Your Husband's Persona Has Collapsed
description: A former award-winning actress is betrayed by her husband and his new star during a film shoot, leading to a tragic end in the snow.
context:
Title: Movie Queen, Your Husband's Persona Has Collapsed
Description: A former award-winning actress is betrayed by her husband and his new star during a film shoot, leading to a tragic end in the snow.

EXT. VILLA SNOW FIELD - NIGHT

Heavy snow falls. Outside a villa glowing with warm light, a vintage street lamp is covered in white snow.

A STUNT COORDINATOR falls from the second-floor balcony into a snowdrift, shouting about a faulty harness. The camera shakes.

A BEST FRIEND rushes out from the villa, chasing after MENG GE.

BEST FRIEND
Meng Ge, the medic said your hands can't grip in this cold!

MENG GE, wearing a thin dress, stands by a fire basin in the center of the snowy ground, holding a dagger, her expression empty.

MENG GE
Then I'll hold on tighter.

She stabs. The blade - weighted wrong, cold steel - sinks in before she can register. Shock floods her face.

MENG GE
(gasping)
...weighted...

The BEST FRIEND looks at her in horror, then at the crew already packing the last gear.

MENG GE lies in the snow, trembling.

DIRECTOR (O.S.)
Cut! Exterior unit wrapped! Report to main set!

The crew members finish loading, departing. The courtyard is silent.

MENG GE whispers weakly.

MENG GE
It was... supposed to be retractable...

XIA WAN and GU YUAN walk over sharing a black umbrella. XIA WAN wears a thick down jacket, her makeup exquisite.

XIA WAN
Sister's commitment to authenticity is... total.

MENG GE looks at them, comprehension replacing agony.

MENG GE
(struggling)
The accident rider... pays out personally...

GU YUAN crouches down, gently stroking MENG GE's cheek, his eyes cold.

GU YUAN
Death by misadventure. You're worth more to me dead than alive.

MENG GE
(in disbelief)
...ten years... for a payout?

GU YUAN
Don't take it personally. It's just insurance.

XIA WAN
We both thank you, Sister. For the legacy.

MENG GE
(agitated)
...my signature... forged?
continuation:
GU YUAN
Amended. You were medicated, remember?

MENG GE
(grief-stricken)
...my phone... records...

GU YUAN
We have it.

He holds up her phone - already wiped.

XIA WAN
Don't worry, Sister. We'll tell your story beautifully.

MENG GE
(weak smile)
...not my story... yours...

She taps her smartwatch - a livestream notification pops up on Gu Yuan's phone: "Meng Ge: Behind the Scenes" - 100K viewers.

GU YUAN
(quietly)
Cancel it.

XIA WAN
How?

GU YUAN
(to MENG GE)
End the stream.

MENG GE
(desperately)
Too late... it's in the cloud...

GU YUAN
Then we find it.

He stands, pulling Xia Wan away. They rush to their car, leaving her.

EXT. VILLA SNOW FIELD - LATER

SHEN NAN runs anxiously into the courtyard.

SHEN NAN
Xiao Ge!

He sees MENG GE's smartwatch, still streaming. He discovers her in the snow.

SHEN NAN rushes over and holds MENG GE in his arms.

SHEN NAN
Xiao Ge! Stay with me!

MENG GE slowly opens her eyes.

MENG GE
(barely breathing)
Shen Nan... did it save?

SHEN NAN
The stream? It's everywhere.

MENG GE
Then I didn't... lose everything...

After speaking, MENG GE's head tilts to the side, and she breathes her last.

FADE OUT.

title: Loop & Call Through Time
description: A mother receives a mysterious phone call from her deceased daughter five years in the past, giving her a chance to prevent the tragedy that took her child's life.
context:
Title: Loop & Call Through Time
Description: A mother receives a mysterious phone call from her deceased daughter five years in the past, giving her a chance to prevent the tragedy that took her child's life.

EXT. PSYCHOLOGY CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

On screen: Year 2024.

SHEN QING sits at the table, a cracked phone clutched in white-knuckled fingers.

SHEN QING
She's been gone five years.

SHEN QING
(quietly)
I could've saved her. That night—

PROFESSOR YANG sits across from her, pen poised over a notepad.

PROFESSOR YANG
How?

SHEN QING places the dead phone on the table between them.

SHEN QING
This phone. It took me back. Five years—to that night.

PROFESSOR YANG
Miss Shen, you understand how that sounds.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

On screen: October 1, 2019, 21:55.

Little girl SHEN NIAN sits on the sofa, holding a doll, phone pressed tight.

SHEN NIAN
Mom, it's National Day. Everyone's home but us.
continuation:
INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN QING, wearing professional attire, paces while talking on the phone. Colleagues wait in the background.

SHEN QING
I know, baby. Tomorrow—first thing.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN NIAN
But...

A shadow spills under the door, stretching across the carpet.

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN QING glances toward the meeting table.

SHEN QING
Meeting's starting. I have to go.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN NIAN
Mom, there's—

The call drops. SHEN NIAN stares at the dark hallway, doll squeezed tight. She steps forward.

The door bursts open. A man fills the frame.

SHEN NIAN
(softly)
...Daddy?

He lunges. The doll hits the floor.

SHEN NIAN
(screaming)
Mom! Mom!

On screen: 21:59.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

SHEN QING wakes from a nightmare, gasping for air. On screen: October 1, 2024, 22:00.

Her HUSBAND is awakened.

HUSBAND
Same nightmare? It's been five years, Qing. Let me get you some water.

HUSBAND gets out of bed. SHEN QING sits up, clutching her smartphone—the wallpaper: SHEN NIAN's last school photo.

SHEN QING
(crying)
You'd be thirteen now. Almost as tall as me.

Suddenly, a childish ringtone sounds.

RINGTONE (V.O.)
Mom, your baby is calling, if you don't answer I'm going to be mad.

SHEN QING freezes. Following the sound, she searches through a storage box beside the bed. From a pile of stuffed animals, she finds the old phone. Its screen glows: incoming call from "Baby Niannian."

SHEN QING
(to herself)
Five years dead. Now it's ringing.

She answers with a trembling thumb.

SHEN QING
...Hello?

Her daughter's voice from five years ago comes through static.

SHEN NIAN (V.O.)
Mom, everyone else is on holiday for National Day, why aren't you coming home?

SHEN QING's face drains of color. The phone slips in her grip.

SHEN QING
(shocked)
Niannian?

title: Heartbeat Transgression
description: Jiang Qiao discovers her fiancé's betrayal at his birthday party, shattering her belief in their childhood engagement and perfect love.
context:
Title: Heartbeat Transgression
Description: Jiang Qiao discovers her fiancé's betrayal at his birthday party, shattering her belief in their childhood engagement and perfect love.

INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY

JIANG QIAO, dressed in an elegant gown, looks around the room.

JIANG QIAO (V.O.)
Twenty years of practice. I still can't tell if this necklace is a promise or a noose.

Several FEMALE GUESTS gather together, holding wine glasses and gossiping.

GUEST A
That heirloom's basically a down payment. Non-refundable.

GUEST B
Childhood engagement? More like a business contract with better PR.

GUEST C
They look right together, though. Shame about the rumors.

GUEST D
Hush. She's right there.

LIN YIN, Jiang Qiao's college classmate, holds a wine glass, watching the distance with complex emotions.

GUEST C
Must be nice. Marrying into that kind of security.

PEI YUNXIAO walks toward JIANG QIAO.

JIANG QIAO (V.O.)
Keep breathing. That's all happiness is anyway.

PEI YUNXIAO takes JIANG QIAO's hand. They walk together to center stage as GUESTS applaud.

PEI YUNXIAO and JIANG QIAO stand still. He waves to the GUESTS.

PEI YUNXIAO
Thank you all for celebrating today. On this occasion, I'm grateful to confirm what many have expected—Miss Jiang Qiao and I will marry this autumn.

GUESTS applaud again, offering congratulations.

GUEST A
Second Young Master Pei, always so traditional!

JIANG QIAO stands beside him, her expression gradually freezing.

The scene becomes dreamlike. Images of GUESTS raising their glasses in celebration overlap with JIANG QIAO's lonely figure.

JIANG QIAO (V.O.)
I thought I was building a life. Turns out I was just decorating a cage.

Tears well up in JIANG QIAO's eyes.
continuation:
EXT. BANQUET HALL GARDEN - NIGHT

JIANG QIAO stands alone in the garden, looking sad.

LIN YIN (O.S.)
Quite the performance. Though I wonder—were you acting for them, or yourself?

The camera turns to a corner where PEI YUNXIAO and LIN YIN are embracing intimately.

PEI YUNXIAO
She's starting to suspect. I saw her checking my phone.

LIN YIN
And yet you still invited me. How reckless.

PEI YUNXIAO
Father's watching. This has to look authentic.

LIN YIN
Authentic. Is that what we are?

PEI YUNXIAO
(quietly bitter)
She's a debt my father owes. You're the choice I made. Even if neither of you can ever know.

JIANG QIAO hides behind a tree, hearing the entire conversation, tears streaming down her face.

LIN YIN
Your little fiancée—what would she do if she found out?

PEI YUNXIAO
She'd stay. Where else would she go?

LIN YIN
You're so certain.

PEI YUNXIAO
I'm necessary.

They kiss—not passionate, but desperate. JIANG QIAO watches this scene in pain.

Suddenly, a hand covers JIANG QIAO's mouth from behind, and another hand covers her eyes. It's PEI ZHIHONG.

PEI ZHIHONG
(whispering)
You can confront them. Or survive them. Choose.

JIANG QIAO, teary-eyed, nods once.

PEI ZHIHONG removes his hands, putting an arm around JIANG QIAO's shoulder, leading her away.

In the distant corridor, two PAPARAZZI are frantically taking photos of PEI YUNXIAO and LIN YIN kissing with their cameras.

title: After Pregnancy! Crying Red Eyes! Miss Shen Won't Look Back (Episode 64)
description: A famous masked singer gives up her career to care for her blind husband, only to discover a shocking betrayal when his sight is restored.
context:
Title: After Pregnancy! Crying Red Eyes! Miss Shen Won't Look Back (Episode 64)
Description: A famous masked singer gives up her career to care for her blind husband, only to discover a shocking betrayal when his sight is restored.

INT. CONCERT STAGE - NIGHT

SHEN QINGYU wears a white wedding dress and an ornate white mask, singing emotionally under the spotlight. The background music is a melancholic song.

SHEN QINGYU
(singing)
Who makes your heart flutter, who makes your heart ache.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

THREE DAYS AGO

A DOCTOR and SHEN QINGYU stand at a ward door, looking through the round window.

DOCTOR
He's refusing treatment. Won't let anyone within six feet.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

GU MINGXUAN sits in a wheelchair, his eyes and wrists wrapped in bandages, his head turned toward the window.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The DOCTOR pushes GU MINGXUAN's wheelchair down the corridor. SHEN QINGYU follows, carrying a small whiteboard.

GU MINGXUAN
(coldly)
Get out. I don't want anyone.

SHEN QINGYU stops, writes quickly on the board, and holds it up: "I'm mute. Not a threat."

GU MINGXUAN
(furious)
I said GET OUT!

He swings his arm, knocking the whiteboard from SHEN QINGYU's hands.

INT. CONCERT STAGE - NIGHT

SHEN QINGYU's fingers tremble on the microphone as she continues singing.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

SHEN QINGYU retrieves the whiteboard. She writes slowly, then holds it before GU MINGXUAN's bandaged eyes: "I'll be your eyes."

She takes his hand. He pulls away, but she gently persists, tracing letters on his palm.

INT. CONCERT STAGE - NIGHT

The song reaches its climax. The fans below go wild with cheers.

FANS
Diva! Diva!

SHEN QINGYU bows. The LED screen behind her displays: "The Final Note - Thank You."

FAN A
One more song! Please!

FAN B
We love you, whoever you are!

NARRATOR (news broadcast)
The mysterious diva vanishes. Her identity remains unknown.

On stage, SHEN QINGYU removes her mask, revealing her face only to the empty air above the audience. No cameras capture this moment. Tears fall.

SHEN QINGYU (V.O.)
Brother Pudding. Little Bottle Cap is coming home.
continuation:
EXT. PARK - DAY

SEVEN YEARS LATER

SHEN QINGYU wears a simple cotton dress, walking with a smile. Her daughter WEIWEI (6) skips beside her.

EXT. PLAZA - DAY

A group of fans hold up a giant poster: "The Masked Diva: 7 Years of Searching."

FAN C
Seven years and we still don't know her name!

FAN D
We'll keep looking. She's out there.

SHEN QINGYU stops at a distance, watching. Weiwei tugs her sleeve.

WEIWEI
Mommy, why are you staring? Do you like masked singers too?

SHEN QINGYU smiles, shakes her head. She pulls out a small notebook, writes: "Legends never fade."

She shows it to the fans as they pass.

FAN D
(nodding)
That's beautiful, thank you.

A fan hands Shen Qingyu a bunny ear headband.

FAN C
For good luck.

SHEN QINGYU accepts it, placing it on Weiwei's head.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

SHEN QINGYU and WEIWEI walk hand in hand. WEIWEI wears the bunny ears.

WEIWEI
Mommy, will Daddy really see us tomorrow?

SHEN QINGYU
(gently)
The doctor confirmed it three times.

WEIWEI
(happily)
Then he'll see me dance! And see YOU!

SHEN QINGYU's hand drifts to her belly. A small smile plays on her lips.

SHEN QINGYU (V.O.)
Seven years of silence. Tomorrow, I'll sing again.

EXT. PARK - OTHER SIDE - DAY

GU MINGXUAN stands in a sharp suit. A DOCTOR removes the final bandage.

WEIWEI
(pointing)
Look! Daddy's bandages are off!

GU MINGXUAN opens his eyes. Blinks. Focuses.

His gaze finds SHEN QINGYU and WEIWEI. His smile begins, then freezes.

He turns his head sharply. His face transforms—recognition, guilt, and something else.

He runs forward.

SHEN QINGYU moves toward him, happiness lighting her face.

GU MINGXUAN runs RIGHT PAST HER.

SHEN QINGYU and WEIWEI freeze.

GU MINGXUAN embraces a WOMAN and SMALL BOY (5) nearby.

SMALL BOY
Daddy! You can see!

SHEN QINGYU's smile shatters. Disbelief. Then a cold, terrible understanding.

GU MINGXUAN looks up, catches her eye across the distance. His face drains of color.

SHEN QINGYU (V.O.)
Seven years of silence. For a lie.

She turns away.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

SHEN QINGYU walks away, pulling WEIWEI with her. Her face is stone.

WEIWEI looks back.

WEIWEI
Mommy?

SHEN QINGYU doesn't answer. Just keeps walking. Resolute.

The bunny ear headband lies abandoned on the path.

title: Survival Guide for a Love-Brained Harem
description: A woman caught in palace intrigue realizes too late that she and her rival are merely pawns in a larger game orchestrated by the Empress.
context:
Title: Survival Guide for a Love-Brained Harem
Description: A woman caught in palace intrigue realizes too late that she and her rival are merely pawns in a larger game orchestrated by the Empress.

EXT. EXECUTION GROUND - DAY

CHENG XIAOXIAO, clothes stained with blood, bound by ropes, kneels on the ground with a desperate expression.

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(crying out)
I beg Your Majesty, in remembrance of our childhood friendship, spare the Cheng family!

CHENG LANG, also bound, kneels nearby.

CHENG LANG
Little sister, you need not do this! The Emperor listens to slander. This kind of foolish ruler does not deserve our Cheng family's loyalty!

Emperor ZHAO RIXING, wearing dragon robes, sits expressionless on the high platform.

Imperial Consort YA HUANYAO stands beside him, speaking to the Emperor.

YA HUANYAO
Your Majesty, although the Cheng family has committed grave crimes, Consort Ru grew up with you as childhood sweethearts. I humbly beg Your Majesty to spare the Cheng family.

ZHAO RIXING coldly picks up the execution token and throws it to the ground.

JAILER
(shouting)
The noon hour has arrived. Proceed with the execution!

The executioner raises his blade. Suddenly, YA HUANYAO leaps forward and blocks the blade aimed at CHENG XIAOXIAO. But the other executioner's blades fall on the rest of the Cheng family.

Blood splatters.

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(heartbroken)
No!

YA HUANYAO reveals a satisfied smile. ZHAO RIXING remains expressionless.

At the execution ground, CHENG LANG and the Cheng family members lie in pools of blood.
continuation:
INT. PRISON CELL - NIGHT

A bright moon hangs high in the night sky.

CHENG XIAOXIAO wakes up on a pile of dry straw, covered in wounds.

YA HUANYAO, dressed in luxurious red robes, slowly walks into the cell, letting out a cold laugh.

YA HUANYAO
(laughing softly)
Ha ha ha.

YA HUANYAO
(coldly)
Well, little sister...

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(angrily)
You wretch! You played the Empress's game to perfection. Was my family's death not enough?

YA HUANYAO
Consort Ru still doesn't see it? We are pieces on the same board. She who holds them wins.

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(shocked)
The Empress... she moves against me?

YA HUANYAO
The shadows warned you. You chose the sun.

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(grabbing YA HUANYAO's robe)
You held the blade for her! My brother's blood is on your hands!

YA HUANYAO
(eyes fierce)
Some debts must be paid in blood... even if mine spills last.

YA HUANYAO turns to leave, then turns back with a cruel smile on her face.

YA HUANYAO
Since the Empress wants you dead, I must fulfill her wish. Guards!

A JAILER enters, eyes lecherous.

JAILER
(grinning wickedly)
Since you're going to die anyway, why not let us brothers have some fun!

ANOTHER JAILER
Right!
