title: Lovebrain Daughter Is Beyond Saving
description: A mother separated from her son during a desperate escape is reunited with him twelve years later, but tragedy strikes when her son-in-law's jealousy leads to a deadly accident.
context:
Title: Lovebrain Daughter Is Beyond Saving
Description: A mother separated from her son during a desperate escape is reunited with him twelve years later, but tragedy strikes when her son-in-law's jealousy leads to a deadly accident.

EXT. DARK FOREST - NIGHT

Rain hammers the canopy. CHANG HUAIYU sprints through mud with young LIU QINGHONG (6) and LIU ZHI (8), clutching a canvas bag. Flashlight beams stab through trees behind them.

DEBT COLLECTOR (V.O.)
Chang Huaiyu! Your husband's factory is bankrupt! The court order's clear—surrender the assets or face fraud charges!

CHANG HUAIYU stumbles, shielding the children. Three SILHOUETTES close in, wielding batons.

DEBT COLLECTOR
Spread out! Check every ditch!

CHANG HUAIYU presses against a fallen tree, her breath ragged. LIU QINGHONG whimpers.

LIU QINGHONG (YOUNG)
(whispering)
Mama, I'm scared...

CHANG HUAIYU
(quietly)
Hold my hand tight. Both of you.

She grips their hands. LIU ZHI's fingers slip in the mud.

LIU ZHI (YOUNG)
(struggling)
Mama, my hand—

A flashlight beam sweeps toward them. CHANG HUAIYU makes a split-second choice—she shoves LIU ZHI under the fallen tree's hollow.

CHANG HUAIYU
(urgent, low)
Stay down. Don't move.

LIU ZHI (YOUNG)
(protesting)
But—

CHANG HUAIYU
Trust Mama.

She breaks a jade pendant from her neck—it's already cracked in one corner. She presses the larger half into LIU ZHI's palm.

CHANG HUAIYU
(whispering)
Your grandmother's pendant. If we get separated... find the match. Now hide.

She covers him with wet leaves just as—

DEBT COLLECTOR (V.O.)
There! By the deadfall!

CHANG HUAIYU scoops up LIU QINGHONG and runs. The lights chase her. LIU ZHI watches through leaves, clutching the pendant, rain washing over him.

ON SCREEN: TWELVE YEARS LATER
continuation:
INT. HIGH-RISE OFFICE - DAY

Adult LIU ZHI (20) stands at the window, running his thumb over the jade half. His ASSISTANT enters, holding a tablet.

LIU ZHI
The investigation?

ASSISTANT
Closed. Your parents returned to Jiangcheng six years ago. They run a small brickworks. You have a sister—Liu Qinghong. Married last year.

The ASSISTANT shows a photo: a modest factory, a family dinner. LIU ZHI's hand trembles.

LIU ZHI
(softly)
They look... ordinary.

ASSISTANT
Sir, the debt was legitimate. Your father signed the bankruptcy papers himself. They weren't victims.

LIU ZHI
(turning away)
I was eight years old. I remember what I remember.

He pockets the jade.

EXT. BRICK FACTORY COURTYARD - DAY

LIU JIANGUO (60s) inspects a cracked brick. CHANG HUAIYU sorts invoices. LIU QINGHONG (18) helps. LI ZICHENG (25) carries water.

LIU JIANGUO
(tossing the brick aside)
This batch is useless. Zicheng, the kiln temperature's been off for weeks.

LI ZICHENG
(measured)
I'm still learning the controls, Dad.

LIU JIANGUO
Learning? You've been here two years. When I was your age—

LIU QINGHONG
(interrupting gently)
Dad, Zicheng's doing his best. The equipment is old.

CHANG HUAIYU
(quietly)
Jianguo, let it be.

LIU JIANGUO mutters, walking away. LI ZICHENG's smile fades. He fills cups, then stops behind a brick stack—structurally unsound, visibly wobbling. He stares at LIU JIANGUO's back.

LI ZICHENG
(under his breath)
Two years. Still the useless son-in-law.

He nudges a loose brick at the base. The stack creaks. He glances around—no one watching. He nudges it again, harder. A single brick topples from the top.

LIU QINGHONG
(looking up)
The stack—

CHANG HUAIYU
(shouting)
Jianguo! Move!

She shoves LIU JIANGUO clear. The stack collapses, bricks thundering down. CHANG HUAIYU stumbles. One brick strikes her temple. She falls, motionless, half-buried.

LIU QINGHONG
(screaming)
Mama!

LI ZICHENG stands frozen, water kettle still in hand.

THE END

title: Just When the Rain Falls
description: A mother's daughter dies while her husband, a doctor, abandons them to save his first love's daughter instead. She vows revenge.
context:
Title: Just When the Rain Falls
Description: A mother's daughter dies while her husband, a doctor, abandons them to save his first love's daughter instead. She vows revenge.

EXT. MILITARY TRAINING GROUND - DAWN

QING'ER, in white martial attire now stained with dust, drills her sword through the morning mist. Her strikes carry a precision that borders on fury.

QING'ER (V.O.)
My daughter died five days ago. By the time I carried her through the storm, there was no blood left to bleed. My husband—the physician sworn to heal—chose to save his first love's child instead.

QING'ER's blade slashes downward, splitting a training dummy clean through.

QING'ER
(whispering to the wind)
Fu Huai'an. Zhou Ran. Blood debts are paid in blood.

LIGHTNING flickers—not in the sky, but in her eyes.

CUT TO BLACK.

TITLE CARD: That Night

EXT. MOUNTAIN VILLAGE - MAIN ROAD - NIGHT

The landslide has reduced the village to rubble and screams. A wooden beam juts from the wreckage, its protruding nail dark with blood.

QING'ER stumbles through the dust, clutching her bleeding daughter AN'AN (7). The child's head lolls, a thin trickle of blood at her temple.

QING'ER
(voice cracking)
Her pulse—can you feel it?

FU HUAI'AN, his physician's sleeve torn, presses fingers to An'an neck. His face tightens with professional assessment.

FU HUAI'AN
Superficial head wound. Stable for now. But the pulse is thready—

A distant cry—feminine, familiar—echoes from below the ridge.

FU HUAI'AN
(turning instinctively)
Ranran's cottage was in the slide path.

QING'ER
(emotional subtext: don't you dare)
Huai'an...

FU HUAI'AN
(avoiding her eyes)
I'll triage and return. Ten minutes.

He grabs his kit. His boots are already moving.

JUN JUN (O.S.)
Uncle Doctor! Please!

QING'ER
(screams after him)
She's your daughter!

But he's vanished into the dust.
continuation:
EXT. ZHOU RAN'S COLLAPSED COTTAGE - NIGHT

FU HUAI'AN finds ZHOU RAN (40s, elegant even in ruin) clutching her daughter JUN JUN. Ran's arm is a mess of blood-soaked silk.

ZHOU RAN
Junjun first. Please.

FU HUAI'AN
(sweeping his light over the girl)
She's unmarked. Shocked, but—

JUN JUN
Mother's arm won't stop bleeding! I tried to tie it but—

FU HUAI'AN
(already cutting the sleeve)
Let me see.

The wound is deep. Not fatal, but arterial. Blood spurts with each heartbeat. His medical training kicks in—pressure, pressure, pressure.

ZHOU RAN
(weakly)
Go. Qing'er needs you...

FU HUAI'AN
(wrapping a tourniquet)
Pressure won't hold. I have to cauterize. Two minutes.

His V.O. is a whispered promise:

FU HUAI'AN (V.O.)
An'an, hold on. Two minutes.

EXT. MOUNTAIN VILLAGE - MAIN ROAD - NIGHT

QING'ER presses her sash to An'an head wound. The white fabric turns crimson. An'an eyes flutter.

AN'AN
Daddy promised... he'd fix me...

QING'ER
He will, sweetheart. He will.

But An'an's breathing has changed—shallow, uneven. The skull fracture is bleeding internally.

AN'AN
Why did Daddy... leave me?

QING'ER
(rocking her)
He didn't. He's coming back.

AN'AN
Cold, Mama...

The rain begins. Not a drizzle—a sudden, biblical pour.

QING'ER
(seeing the truth in her daughter's fading eyes)
No. No no no—

She lifts An'an. Runs. The mud sucks at her boots. The rain erases the path.

EXT. MEDICAL DISTRICT - NIGHT

QING'ER staggers down a street of shuttered clinics. Each door she hammers on is locked, dark.

QING'ER
(screaming over the storm)
Anyone! Apothecary! Midwife! Please!

Her fist leaves blood on the third door. No answer.

QING'ER
(collapsing)
I'll trade my life—just save hers...

An'an's head lolls against her shoulder. The rain washes them both clean.

FADE OUT.

title: Love Moves the Little Rose
description: A woman waits alone on her birthday, only to be reminded by her lover that she is merely a substitute for someone else.
context:
Title: Love Moves the Little Rose
Description: A woman waits alone on her birthday, only to be reminded by her lover that she is merely a substitute for someone else.

INT. UPSCALE RESTAURANT - NIGHT

ZHU YAO (28, elegant exhaustion) sits alone at a table with a birthday cake in front of her. She gazes out the window with a forlorn expression.

A WAITER approaches carrying a tray with a glass of water.

WAITER
Miss, it's nine o'clock. Would you like to order now?

ZHU YAO picks up the glass and takes a sip.

ZHU YAO
Not yet.

WAITER
Alright.

The WAITER turns and leaves.

ZHU YAO takes out her phone. The lock screen shows a photo of her with a man—arms around each other, but their eyes don't meet. The time reads 21:04. She unlocks the phone and sends the man a message.

PHONE SCREEN displays the message: "Are you coming?"

Soon, a reply comes back.

PHONE SCREEN displays the message: "Yangyang woke up. I'm staying with her tonight."

ZHU YAO's expression freezes. Tears well up in her eyes, and one tear slides down her cheek.

ZHU YAO (V.O.)
Three years. Same script. Different night.

CUT TO:

Another part of the restaurant. SHEN SHIWU (30, sharp suit) sits alone, drinking red wine pensively. He watches Zhu Yao's reflection in the mirror behind the bar.
continuation:
A FLOWER GIRL approaches SHEN SHIWU's table.

FLOWER GIRL
Last rose, mister?

SHEN SHIWU takes a red rose from the girl's basket and hands her money. The girl glances at Zhu Yao, understanding.

ZHU YAO looks down and continues typing on her phone.

PHONE SCREEN displays the message: "Thirty minutes. Please. It's my birthday."

As soon as the message is sent, a reply comes back immediately.

PHONE SCREEN displays the message: "Zhu Yao. Don't make me remind you what you signed."

ZHU YAO looks at the message, completely heartbroken.

At that moment, the FLOWER GIRL walks to ZHU YAO's table carrying her basket.

FLOWER GIRL
Miss.

ZHU YAO looks up and forces a smile.

ZHU YAO
I'm not buying roses, but thank you, little one.

The FLOWER GIRL takes a red rose from her basket and hands it to ZHU YAO.

FLOWER GIRL
He said... "You weren't really waiting for him."

ZHU YAO is stunned. She follows the girl's gaze.

SHEN SHIWU is at the front desk settling his bill. He leaves a business card by his glass, then turns and leaves the restaurant.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED...

title: May You Be Well
description: A princess raised by the royal family volunteers for a political marriage to a distant land after the prince she loves chooses another, hiding her heartbreak behind duty.
context:
Title: May You Be Well
Description: A princess raised by the royal family volunteers for a political marriage to a distant land after the prince she loves chooses another, hiding her heartbreak behind duty.

INT. IMPERIAL PALACE THRONE ROOM - DAY

The EMPEROR sits on his throne, a sealed missive in his hands. JIANG NING kneels before him.

EMPEROR
Jiang Ning, Western Xia's latest raiding party was turned back at the border. Their Khan now offers peace... through marriage. You know what they are like. The cold, the harshness. Why would you offer yourself?

JIANG NING
Your Majesty took me in when I had nothing. This marriage brings peace without costing a true princess. It is my duty... and perhaps my only path forward.

EMPEROR
Your bond with the Crown Prince spans so many years. If you need time...

JIANG NING
Time changes nothing, Your Majesty. Action does.

EXT. OUTSIDE THE CITY - DAY

ON SCREEN: Fifteen days earlier

JIANG NING stands in the crowd, beaming as she clutches a handkerchief. Two PASSERSBY whisper behind her.

PASSERBY A
The Crown Prince returns victorious. His Majesty himself comes to greet him. Mark my words - he'll finally claim what's been his all these years.

PASSERBY B
One would think. Though I hear Minister Meng has been rather visible at court lately. And his daughter's dowry includes the northern garrison's loyalty.

The Crown Prince's procession thunders into view. PEI YAN, armor gleaming, reins his warhorse before the EMPEROR and assembled court.

JIANG NING darts forward, offering her handkerchief. PEI YAN's eyes meet hers briefly - then look away. He dismounts and kneels.

PEI YAN
Father Emperor, I ask but one reward for my service: your blessing to take a wife.

EMPEROR
Your patience these years has not gone unnoticed. Rise, my son, and claim...

PEI YAN
Minister Meng's daughter, Lanxin. As Crown Princess.

JIANG NING's handkerchief slips from her fingers. The crowd's murmur rises around her.

PASSERBY B
Beggar girl playing princess. Who would have her now?

PEI YAN rises, approaches Jiang Ning. He takes her hand - a final, false tenderness.

PEI YAN
(loud enough for all to hear)
She saved my life once. For that, she deserves honor. But the Crown Princess must be worthy of the throne. Blood tells, Father. And hers is common.

He drops her hand. Jiang Ning's tears fall silently.

EMPEROR
You dishonor her publicly? You dishonor yourself.

PEI YAN
I secure your empire. Minister Meng's support is worth more than nostalgia.
continuation:
INT. IMPERIAL PALACE THRONE ROOM - DAY

JIANG NING (V.O.)
Blood tells, he said. So let it speak elsewhere.

JIANG NING
Western Xia knows me only as a princess of the realm. My fluency in their tongue is a weapon no envoy carries. Let me be useful, Your Majesty. Let me be gone.

She bows low, her forehead to the ground. The Emperor studies her - seeing not a broken girl, but a strategist born.

EMPEROR
After the New Year. The decree will be sealed.

JIANG NING
One request, Your Majesty. Let the Crown Prince believe it is his idea. That I go because I am... in the way.

EMPEROR
You would protect his pride even now?

JIANG NING
I would protect the alliance. He need not know until I am beyond recall.

EXT. PALACE SIDE COURTYARD - DAY

MENG LANXIN practices archery with several HANDMAIDENS. Her precision is cold, mechanical.

HANDMAIDEN A
They say Princess Anning petitioned His Majesty.

HANDMAIDEN B
Her name hasn't even been cleared from the palace rolls. She could still make trouble...

MENG LANXIN (V.O.)
Trouble. Yes. The kind that whispers of sacrifice and makes princes feel guilt.

She spots JIANG NING walking with her attendants in the distance. Meng Lanxin draws, holds - then shifts her aim slightly.

The arrow whistles past Jiang Ning's face, embedding in a pillar. A warning. A message.

JIANG NING touches her unmarked cheek, understanding. She meets Meng Lanxin's gaze - and nods once, acknowledging the hit.

Without a word, Jiang Ning turns and walks on. The arrow remains quivering behind her.

title: I Am Not the World's Number One
description: Chu Ran, once the world's greatest martial artist, became a beggar after sealing away his powers following his wife's tragic death. When a woman with his late wife's face appears, his past resurfaces.
context:
Title: I Am Not the World's Number One
Description: Chu Ran, once the world's greatest martial artist, became a beggar after sealing away his powers following his wife's tragic death. When a woman with his late wife's face appears, his past resurfaces.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

An elderly STORYTELLER talks animatedly to several young BEGGARS. CHU RAN, a destitute beggar, lies on a pile of straw nearby, his hands trembling.

STORYTELLER
You ask me who is the strongest in the world? Who is the strongest in the world? That would be Chu Ran, the great hero Chu.

EXT. LAKESIDE/CLIFF - DAY (FLASHBACK)

CHU RAN, dressed in white robes, displays extraordinary martial arts skills, running across water and fighting numerous men in black.

STORYTELLER (V.O.)
Legend has it that Hero Chu mastered all martial arts by age thirteen, reached the transcendent realm at twenty, and was only one step away from shattering the void.

CHU RAN easily defeats several enemies, finally splitting a massive rock with his sword, carving the words "Number One Under Heaven."

STORYTELLER (V.O.)
Two years ago, at Meteor Immortal Cliff, he defeated the Four Absolutes and finally claimed the title of Number One Under Heaven.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

YOUNG BEGGAR A
What happened after that?

STORYTELLER
After that? After that, Hero Chu naturally ascended to the Immortal World. Or so they say.

CHU RAN
(weakly)
He did not ascend. He became a beggar.

YOUNG BEGGAR B
What kind of joke is that! With that kind of power, why would he become a beggar?

CHU RAN (V.O.)
That's because...
continuation:
EXT. LAKESIDE/CLIFF - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

CHU RAN'S WIFE runs toward CHU RAN and embraces him, crying tears of joy.

CHU RAN'S WIFE
Chu Ran, you were gone so long. I was so afraid.

CHU RAN (V.O.)
Two years ago, after I defeated the Four Absolutes, my enemies didn't just want revenge. They wanted to destroy what I loved.

An ENEMY emerges from shadows with a crossbow. Chu Ran's guard is down. The BOLT flies—not at him, but at his wife. She sees it, and in that split second, pushes Chu Ran aside. The BOLT takes her in the chest.

Chu Ran catches her as she falls, his face transforming from joy to horror. He crushes the crossbow mechanism with a glance, killing the hidden archer instantly, but it's too late.

CHU RAN holds his dying wife, grief-stricken.

CHU RAN
Qingcheng... my qi can still save you—

CHU RAN'S WIFE
(weakly, blood on her lips)
No... promise me something. Promise you'll stop being their hero. Just... be a man who lives.

CHU RAN (V.O.)
I spent a lifetime conquering the heavens, but couldn't protect the one thing that made earth worth standing on.

CHU RAN
(broken)
Qingcheng...

CHU RAN (V.O.)
That night, I shattered my own cultivation. Every meridian. Every technique. I killed my power, not sealed it.

EXT. COURTYARD/STREET - DAY

A woman in black runs frantically into the courtyard, pursued by several WARRIORS. Her clothes are torn, but her bearing suggests nobility.

PURSUED WOMAN
Please! Help me!

MU FAMILY WARRIOR
Traitor! There's nowhere left to run!

YOUNG BEGGAR A
Those are the Mu family warriors! They don't leave witnesses!

The young BEGGARS and the STORYTELLER hurriedly flee. CHU RAN remains lying in place, his trembling hands clenched.

CHU RAN (INTERNAL MONOLOGUE)
Number One Under Heaven. What good is a title when I couldn't even save her? Let the world burn. I won't play their games anymore.

The PURSUED WOMAN is cornered. She stops and turns around, breathing hard. Her face is identical to CHU RAN'S deceased wife, down to the small scar above her left eyebrow. CHU RAN's eyes snap open. He stares, his face draining of color. His trembling hands go still.

CHU RAN
(shocked)
Wife?

title: After I Stopped Loving Her, My Cold Ex-Wife Cried
description: A devoted husband returns from France with a surprise for his wife on their tenth anniversary, only to discover a devastating betrayal.
context:
Title: After I Stopped Loving Her, My Cold Ex-Wife Cried
Description: A devoted husband returns from France with a surprise for his wife on their tenth anniversary, only to discover a devastating betrayal.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL STREET - DAY

A rainy day, the street is wet. LIN HUAI, a man in a trench coat, pulls a suitcase and holds a transparent umbrella, walking hurriedly.

LIN HUAI (V.O.)
Ten years today. Three months in Paris. She thinks I'm still there.

LIN HUAI wears wireless earbuds, on a phone call, smiling.

FRIEND (PHONE)
Lin Huai, you're back already?

LIN HUAI
Lang Lang signed the recommendation. No need to stay.

FRIEND (PHONE)
Three months busking at the opera? That's not devotion, that's a ghost story.

LIN HUAI
I'm home now. Talk later.

LIN HUAI removes his earbuds, ending the call. He looks ahead, his face glowing with anticipation.

LIN HUAI (V.O.)
She always said her music needed Paris. I finally gave it to her.

In LIN HUAI's line of sight appears a young man, SU HAN, wearing a blue jacket and holding a bouquet of flowers, talking on the phone.

SU HAN (PHONE)
See me? I flew back. Come down.

LIN HUAI watches SU HAN, somewhat curious.

SU HAN (V.O.)
Gu Nian, I've memorized every piece you love. Stop pretending.
continuation:
INT. OPEN SPACE DOWNSTAIRS - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Young SU HAN kneels on one knee, surrounded by candles arranged in a heart shape. He confesses to young GU NIAN.

SU HAN
Will you be with me?

GU NIAN
I...

FRIENDS (O.S.)
Together! Together! Together!

GU NIAN accepts the flowers, her eyes on someone outside the circle.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL STREET - DAY

LIN HUAI watches SU HAN in the distance, smiling and shaking his head.

LIN HUAI
(to himself)
Youth.

LIN HUAI takes out his phone, preparing to send a voice message to his wife.

LIN HUAI
(into the phone)
Honey, there's a guy downstairs with flowers...

Before he finishes, GU NIAN runs out of the building. She runs straight to SU HAN, and they embrace tightly.

GU NIAN
Why didn't you tell me?

SU HAN
I needed to see you first.

They gaze at each other, then kiss carefully, like a secret.

LIN HUAI stands not far away, witnessing everything. The umbrella slips from his hand and falls onto the wet ground. The smile on his face freezes, his eyes filled with shock and disbelief.

LIN HUAI
(shocked)
Honey?

The phone screen shows: "Recording..."
group_id: after i stopped loving her, my cold ex-wife cried

title: I Help the Empress Stabilize the Empire
description: A 21st-century ammunition engineer is transported to an ancient dynasty where he must serve as a eunuch in the Empress's palace while hiding his true identity.
context:
Title: I Help the Empress Stabilize the Empire
Description: A 21st-century ammunition engineer is transported to an ancient dynasty where he must serve as a eunuch in the Empress's palace while hiding his true identity.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

A high-tech ammunition lab. Warning lights strobe. SENIOR ENGINEER ZHANG YI monitors glowing screens while LI TIANLE (26, sharp-eyed) preps a prototype.

ZHANG YI
Ready for velocity calibration. Tianle, final check on the propellant mix.

LI TIANLE
(grinning)
Optimized for stability. This batch won't combust prematurely—

The control panel erupts in sparks. Tianle lunges for the emergency shutdown but a blinding energy surge envelops him—

INT. EUNUCH'S QUARTERS - NIGHT

Lightning cracks through a window. LI TIANLE jolts awake on an ancient bed, spasming. He touches his temple—blood. Silk robes replace his lab coat.

He notices the eunuch's red uniform. His face drains.

LI TIANLE
(whisper)
No...

He checks himself frantically—exhales in relief.

LI TIANLE
(loud whisper)
Thank god.

A knock sounds at the door.

PALACE MAID (O.S.)
Eunuch Li! Her Majesty's bath is drawn. Don't keep her waiting.

LI TIANLE
(stalling)
Just—just preparing the oils!

PALACE MAID (O.S.)
The Empress tolerates many things. Tardiness isn't one.

Footsteps recede. Li Tianle paces, pressing his forehead.

LI TIANLE (V.O.)
Gunpowder equations I understand. Imperial protocol?

He spots a scroll: "Palace Conduct for Eunuchs." His engineer's eye scans it methodically.

LI TIANLE (V.O.)
Okay. Variables: one volatile Empress. Constant: my head on the block. Solution: survive tonight, escape tomorrow.
continuation:
INT. BATHHOUSE - NIGHT

Steam clouds the chamber. The EMPRESS (30s, steel in her eyes) soaks, flanked by silent maids. Li Tianle enters, tray balanced with surgical precision.

EMPRESS
Xiao Lizi. The towel.

LI TIANLE
(eyes averted)
Yes, Your Majesty.

He moves forward—his foot hits a wet patch. The tray flies. He grabs instinctively—hands land on her shoulders. The maid GASPS.

EMPRESS
(frozen fury)
You dare.

LI TIANLE
(voice cracking)
The coefficient of friction on wet cypress is—

EMPRESS
What?

LI TIANLE
(releasing her)
—nothing, Your Majesty. My profound apologies.

EMPRESS
Get out. Kneel in the courtyard until dawn.

LI TIANLE
(retreating)
Yes. Yes, of course.

EUNUCH WANG enters, bowing deeply.

EUNUCH WANG
Your Majesty, the Duke of Qi demands immediate audience. He brings... soldiers.

EMPRESS
(laughs bitterly)
Of course he does. Even my bath isn't sacred.

She rises, water dripping. A maid wraps her in silk. She glances at Li Tianle—her look sharpens.

EMPRESS
Bring the clumsy one. Let him witness what happens when men overstep.

A PALACE MAID walks to LI TIANLE's side and whispers urgently.

PALACE MAID
Follow. Now.

LI TIANLE
(quietly)
This is a containment breach. Worst kind.

He trails the procession, his engineer's mind already calculating angles of escape.

title: My Name is Ruan Tiantian & I Haven't Been a Villainess in Years
description: A delivery worker accidentally spills milk tea on a woman's designer bag, leading to an unexpected confrontation and a shocking discovery at home.
context:
Title: My Name is Ruan Tiantian & I Haven't Been a Villainess in Years
Description: A delivery worker accidentally spills milk tea on a woman's designer bag, leading to an unexpected confrontation and a shocking discovery at home.

EXT. STREET - DAY

A DELIVERY WORKER runs while talking on the phone.

DELIVERY WORKER
Almost there, almost there.

The DELIVERY WORKER carefully bumps into the WIFE, spilling milk tea on her and her designer bag.

DELIVERY WORKER
I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

WIFE
You blind idiot.

DELIVERY WORKER
I'm sorry, my order is about to be late.

WIFE
I don't care if it's late! If you damage something, you pay! If you don't pay, I'll sue! Pay up now!

DELIVERY WORKER
How much?

WIFE
Twenty-eight thousand!

DELIVERY WORKER
(shocked)
What? I... I don't have that much money. I can't afford such an expensive bag.

WIFE
That's for trying to run. The bag is fine. The Supreme Triple Milk Tea was eight yuan. Consider the rest a life lesson.

DELIVERY WORKER
(confused)
I don't understand—

WIFE
Pay the eight yuan and disappear.

The DELIVERY WORKER pays and runs off. The WIFE watches him, then pulls a fresh milk tea from her bag, pouring the remnants into it.
continuation:
INT. HOME - DAY

The WIFE returns home carrying the milk tea.

WIFE
Lao Hao, I'm back!

The WIFE pushes open the bedroom door and sees her HUSBAND with a MISTRESS in bed. She freezes, her expression shifting from shock to cold fury.

WIFE
(furious)
You bastard.

The WIFE throws the milk tea in her hand at them. Quick cuts show the HUSBAND being beaten.

The HUSBAND lies on the floor with a black eye and swollen face, a straw stuck in his nostril, moaning in pain.

The WIFE looks at her HUSBAND on the floor, then turns to the MISTRESS on the bed.

WIFE
Now it's your turn.

The MISTRESS stands up, revealing her pregnant belly, and raises her hand to stop her.

MISTRESS
I'm pregnant!

The WIFE freezes. The HUSBAND on the floor also shows a surprised expression.

HUSBAND
...What?

title: My Undercover Life in Ancient Times - The Tale of Lu Ding
description: A modern man accidentally travels back in time to ancient China and finds himself caught up in a revolutionary plot to infiltrate the palace.
context:
Title: My Undercover Life in Ancient Times - The Tale of Lu Ding
Description: A modern man accidentally travels back in time to ancient China and finds himself caught up in a revolutionary plot to infiltrate the palace.

INT. SWIMMING POOL - NIGHT

XIAO BAO mops the pool deck after hours. TWO WOMEN in bathing suits walk past, chatting.

One of the WOMEN suddenly spots him near a decorative fountain and screams.

WOMAN
(terrified)
Help! Intruder!

XIAO BAO startles, drops his mop. It strikes a hidden switch on the fountain base. A MECHANICAL WHIRR. The fountain splits open, revealing an ANCIENT BRONZE MIRROR.

XIAO BAO
What the—

He reaches for it, trips on the wet floor, and falls. As he collides with the mirror, BLINDING LIGHT engulfs the screen.

INT. QIANKUN HALL - NIGHT

XIAO BAO lies on cold stone floor. TORCHES flicker. MEN in ancient costumes hold torches, standing with serious expressions. Plaque above reads "Qiankun Hall." Banners reading "Overthrow Qian, Restore Zhou" and "Restore the Great Zhou" hang in front of the hall.

CHEN JINBEI stands before the crowd, speaking passionately.

CHEN JINBEI
The Qian Emperor's tyranny ends now! Qiankun Hall will restore the Great Zhou!

XIAO BAO scrambles up, patting himself in disbelief.

XIAO BAO (V.O.)
This isn't a set... this is real.

MEMBER A
(whispering to XIAO BAO)
Xiao Bao! Keep your voice down!

MEMBER B
(pointing at CHEN JINBEI)
Chen Jinbei, leader of Qiankun Hall.

MEMBER A
Today we're selecting the two hundred and fiftieth hero to go undercover in the palace.

MEMBER B
Two hundred and forty-nine have fallen. Keep your head down.

CHEN JINBEI
(shouting)
continuation:
Complete the great cause!

The crowd retreats, no one daring to come forward.

XIAO BAO (V.O.)
They think I'm Xiao Bao. According to history, Xiao Bao volunteers. But 249 people died. I'm not sticking my neck out.

CHEN JINBEI
Good! We'll do it the old way.

XIAO BAO (V.O.)
I'm a college student. I've got cheat codes. I know the plot. I'll grab a chair and sit this out.

Music plays. Everyone begins playing musical chairs. The music stops. Everyone has found a seat except XIAO BAO, who stands there dumbfounded.

XIAO BAO (V.O.)
(stunned)
Damn. Even ancient China is this competitive.

CHEN JINBEI
Hero, wait.

CHEN JINBEI walks up to XIAO BAO and excitedly grabs his shoulders.

CHEN JINBEI
In our Qiankun Hall, the previous two hundred and forty-nine palace undercover agents were all chosen by lottery. Today, finally, a hero has emerged!

XIAO BAO
(helplessly)
Please, there's been a mistake—

WANG CHUNHUA (V.O.)
Let him go!

A woman in red clothes with elaborate makeup—WANG CHUNHUA—walks in, waving a fan.

CHEN JINBEI
(warily)
State your business.

WANG CHUNHUA
Wang Chunhua of Yihong Brothel. You'd best remember my name.

XIAO BAO sees WANG CHUNHUA, his eyes light up with impossible recognition.

XIAO BAO
(surprised)
Mom?

Both WANG CHUNHUA and CHEN JINBEI freeze.
group_id: my undercover life in ancient times - the tale of lu ding

title: I Would Brave Thorns for You
description: A powerful CEO returns to his homeland after fifteen years to finally reunite with his long-lost younger sister, whose token has been discovered at a nightclub.
context:
Title: I Would Brave Thorns for You
Description: A powerful CEO returns to his homeland after fifteen years to finally reunite with his long-lost younger sister, whose token has been discovered at a nightclub.

INT. LAWN - DAY

SU YE descends from a helicopter, his composure absolute. A SUBORDINATE bolts forward, intercepting him.

MEN IN BLACK
Welcome back, President Su!

SUBORDINATE
(catching his breath)
Sir—the young miss's token. Platinum Bar.

The Subordinate extends a photograph. Su Ye's gloved fingers hesitate a millisecond before taking it.

SU YE (V.O.)
Ranran's whistle. I'd know it in my sleep.

SU YE
(to himself)
Fifteen years...

His jaw tightens imperceptibly.

SU YE
Mobilize everyone. And wake my brothers.

SUBORDINATE
All five, sir?

SU YE
Every single one. We bring her home tonight.

INT. OUTSIDE OPERATING ROOM - DAY

SU QI scrubs his hands at a sink, the water running red. He shuts it off with deliberate calm.

SU QI
(to himself)
Thirty hours. Worth it.

He turns to find a NURSE holding his phone.

NURSE
Urgent call, Doctor Su. It's about the patient in three.

SU QI
Tell them I've resigned as chief.
(softly)
I'm needed elsewhere.
continuation:
INT. FILMING LOCATION - DAY

SU XUN emerges from a sea of screaming fans, flawless. His AGENT trails behind.

AGENT
The sequel's been moved up! We shoot tomorrow—

SU XUN
(putting on sunglasses)
Cancel it.

AGENT
Your career—!

SU XUN
(smiling coldly)
My sister's been found. That's my career now.
(to the fans)
Family emergency. The permanent kind.

INT. AUCTION HOUSE - DAY

The AUCTIONEER's voice cracks with excitement.

AUCTIONEER
Six hundred million! Do I hear—?

SU ZHUOZE's voice cuts through, unhurried.

SU ZHUOZE
One billion. For everything.

Silence. He leans into the light.

SU ZHUOZE
My sister shouldn't have to choose.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

SU LIN stands in a corridor of unconscious security personnel, adjusting his cufflinks.

SU LIN
(into phone)
Platinum Bar. Ownership transfer. Tonight.

He pockets the phone, addressing the groaning man at his feet.

SU LIN
Apologies for the mess.
(smoothly)
Family business. You understand.

INT. CAR - DAY

SU ZHE holds a creased photograph, his thumb wearing through the corner. The city blurs past.

ASSISTANT
Sixth Young Master... Miss Feifei's birthday. Platinum Bar. She's—persistent.

SU ZHE
(folding the photo with care)
Tell her I'm coming.
(quietly)
And that I'll be taking someone far more important with me.

title: I Brought My Daughter Local Chickens, She Held My Funeral
description: A father's tragic loss and his struggle to raise his daughter, only to face betrayal and heartbreak.
context:
Title: I Brought My Daughter Local Chickens, She Held My Funeral
Description: A father's tragic loss and his struggle to raise his daughter, only to face betrayal and heartbreak.

EXT. FUNERAL HALL - DAY

The sound of mournful horns fills the air. A banner reading "In Solemn Mourning" hangs in the hall. LU YONGCHANG and his daughter LU YUEXI, both dressed in mourning clothes, kneel on the ground.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
Filial sons and virtuous descendants, take your positions before the spirit.

Relatives and friends step forward one by one to bow.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
First bow! Second bow! Third bow!

VILLAGER A (V.O.)
Lu Yongchang's life is so bitter. He finally had a daughter in his old age, and now his wife is gone and his leg is broken. How will he manage in the days to come?

LU YUEXI has an injury on her forehead, freshly bandaged. She looks up at her grieving father.

LU YUEXI
Dad... is Mom in pain anymore?

LU YONGCHANG can no longer control his emotions. He holds his daughter and breaks down crying.

INT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

Flashback to the past.

LU YUEXI sits by a pile of bricks at the construction site, drawing seriously. A chicken feather is tucked behind her ear.

LU YONGCHANG, drenched in sweat, carries cement bags in the distance, his steps unsteady.

COWORKER
Payday!

COWORKER
Old Lu, stop carrying! Time to collect your pay!

LU YONGCHANG
You guys go first. I'll carry two more bags.

LU YONGCHANG struggles to lift another bag. After a few steps, his legs give out and the cement bag falls to the ground, breaking open.

The FOREMAN walks over, looking displeased.

FOREMAN
What's going on? Can you do the job or not? If not, leave!

LU YONGCHANG
(urgently)
I can do it. You can't fire me. I still have a daughter to support—and chicks to buy!

LU YONGCHANG struggles and uses all his strength to pick up the broken cement bag, walking forward with difficulty.

LU YUEXI
Dad!

LU YONGCHANG puts down the cement bag, a smile appearing on his weary face.

LU YONGCHANG
Ah, my daughter!

LU YUEXI
(holding up a drawing)
Look at the big house I drew. That's you and Mom, and me. And chickens.

LU YONGCHANG looks at the drawing, tears in his eyes, deeply moved.

LU YONGCHANG
My daughter draws so well!

The FOREMAN walks over.

FOREMAN
I've told you so many times not to bring kids here. Why did you bring your daughter again? What kind of father are you?

LU YONGCHANG
(smiling apologetically)
It won't happen again. Look how well my daughter draws.

FOREMAN
(handing over money)
Here's your pay.

LU YONGCHANG
(taking the money)
Thank you, boss.

FOREMAN
Hey, wait. Old Zhang!

A worker throws over a large checkered woven bag. The FOREMAN catches it and hands it to LU YONGCHANG.

FOREMAN
Was going to throw it away. Give it to your daughter.

LU YONGCHANG is stunned, then bows gratefully.

LU YONGCHANG
Thank you, boss!

LU YONGCHANG opens the bag. Inside are some old clothes.

LU YONGCHANG
(to his daughter)
Daughter, look, we have new clothes to wear.

LU YUEXI
Dad, you worked so hard.

His daughter reaches out her small hand to wipe the sweat and dust from LU YONGCHANG's face.

LU YONGCHANG
(moved)
Yuexi, Dad will definitely give you a good life in the future.
continuation:
EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

LU YONGCHANG lets Yuexi ride on his shoulders. Father and daughter happily sing as they walk down the road.

LU YONGCHANG & LU YUEXI
(singing)
The dark sky hangs low, bright stars follow along...

LU YUEXI
Dad, I'm hungry.

EXT. STEAMED BUN SHOP - DAY

LU YONGCHANG brings Yuexi to a steamed bun shop.

LU YONGCHANG
Boss, two buns please.

BUN SHOP OWNER
Coming right up! Here you go, little girl.

LU YONGCHANG
Okay, good.

As LU YONGCHANG pays, he notices a little girl in ragged clothes with a dirty face (LU QINGYAO) sitting not far away, staring at them longingly. A scar marks her temple.

BUN SHOP OWNER
Ah, that little beggar has no parents. She'll starve to death sooner or later. So pitiful.

LU YONGCHANG looks at the little beggar, then at the change in his hand, his face showing compassion and sudden recognition.

LU YONGCHANG
Give me two more steamed buns... make that two more buns.

BUN SHOP OWNER
Right away.

LU YONGCHANG takes the buns and walks over to the little beggar, crouching down.

LU YONGCHANG
Little girl.

He hands the buns to the little beggar. She takes them and devours them hungrily.

LU YONGCHANG turns to leave with Yuexi. The little beggar silently follows behind them.

LU YUEXI
Dad, this sister is so pitiful. But we barely have enough.

LU YONGCHANG stops, turns back to look at the little beggar, struggling internally. He finally crouches down and asks gently.

LU YONGCHANG
Little girl, would you like to come home with us?

The little beggar hesitates, then nods vigorously, a shy smile appearing on her face.

LU YONGCHANG
(to Yuexi)
Yuexi, from now on you have an older sister.

Yuexi smiles, though her eyes hold a flicker of uncertainty.

LU YONGCHANG holds Yuexi with one hand and Qingyao with the other. The three of them walk home together.

title: New Year's Eve
description: On New Year's Eve, a wife catches her husband in bed with her best friend and demands a divorce, but the husband suspects it's all a setup orchestrated by her brother.
context:
Title: New Year's Eve
Description: On New Year's Eve, a wife catches her husband in bed with her best friend and demands a divorce, but the husband suspects it's all a setup orchestrated by her brother.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

GU YANZHI and XIAOXIAO (YE XIAO's best friend) are asleep in bed, champagne glasses on the nightstand.

YE XIAO bursts in with brother YE XI and AUNT LIU.

YE XIAO yanks the blanket off.

YE XIAO
(barely controlled)
Happy New Year, husband. My best friend.

XIAOXIAO
(waking, panicked)
Xiaoxiao—wait—I don't remember—I was at the party—

YE XIAO
The party I threw for us.

YE XIAO grabs for XIAOXIAO. Chaos erupts.

XIAOXIAO
(covering herself)
I swear, there's something wrong with me—

YE XI
Sis, your medication. Remember your heart.

YE XIAO
(turning to GU YANZHI)
Sign it. Every page.

YE XIAO slams a document on GU YANZHI's chest.

GU YANZHI
(in disbelief)
Divorce papers?
continuation:
GU YANZHI flips through the document. "Divorce Agreement - Revised 12/30" is stamped on top.

GU YANZHI
(quietly)
You had them ready before tonight. Before you even knew.

GU YANZHI
(to YE XIAO)
Ten years. Did you ever believe in us?

YE XI
(stepping closer)
She believes in evidence. Right here, in our family home.

GU YANZHI
(to YE XI)
The emergency board meeting. Tomorrow morning. You need me out before then.

GU YANZHI
(to YE XIAO)
He's been planning this. Ask him about the shares.

YE XI
(nervously)
He's desperate, sis. Don't fall for it—

GU YANZHI
(grabs YE XI's collar)
Show her your phone. The texts.

GU YANZHI shoves YE XI against the wall, hand on his throat.

YE XI
(gasping)
You're insane!

YE XIAO
(pulling GU YANZHI back)
Stop! Stop—

YE XIAO freezes. A phone on the floor shows a message: "She's coming. Make it convincing."

title: Found the Wife - She's Dating on a Romance Show
description: A woman wakes up at her own funeral to find herself in another person's body, desperately searching for her lost child.
context:
Title: Found the Wife - She's Dating on a Romance Show
Description: A woman wakes up at her own funeral to find herself in another person's body, desperately searching for her lost child.

INT. FUNERAL HALL - DAY

The funeral hall is arranged with cold elegance, white roses surrounding an open casket. A banner reads: "Farewell to Su Shangjing."

A young woman, SU SHANGJING, dressed in white, lies in the casket. Her black and white portrait is placed in front.

GUESTS in black clothing bow under the direction of a MASTER OF CEREMONIES.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
First bow.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
Second bow.

CLOSE-UP - SU SHANGJING's hands folded on her chest. Her fingers twitch slightly.

A FEMALE GUEST's eyes widen in horror, pointing at the casket.

FEMALE GUEST A
She moved! The body moved!

Everyone looks over, their faces showing alarm.

CUT TO: FLASHBACK

INT. SHABBY BEDROOM - 2019 - DAY

GU YUNUO lies on a bed, giving birth. A MIDWIFE and LIN YUEE attend her.

MIDWIFE
Push! Harder!

LIN YUEE
That's it!

A baby's cry. GU YUNUO looks at the child, exhausted but relieved.

LIN YUEE's expression darkens. She grabs the child.

LIN YUEE
A bastard child with no father? I'll give it a real home.

GU YUNUO
(panicked)
Aunt Lin, no! My baby...

GU YUNUO struggles to reach her child.

GU YUNUO
Please... give him back...

LIN YUEE
(viciously)
You're not fit to be a mother!

LIN YUEE shoves GU YUNUO. Her head slams against the bedside table. Blood flows as she loses consciousness.

LIN YUEE
(to the child, calculating)
Mr. Lin pays well for baby boys.

BACK TO: PRESENT
continuation:
INT. FUNERAL HALL - DAY

The body's eyes snap open. She sits up abruptly.

SU SHANGJING (with GU YUNUO's consciousness)
My child!

The GUESTS scatter in terror, screaming.

GUESTS
(V.O.)
A ghost! A ghost!

YAN JINCHUAN stands in place, looking at her coldly.

YAN JINCHUAN
You really didn't die.

FEMALE GUEST B
(to her companion)
I thought when President Yan divorced her on that dating show, she'd at least have the decency to stay dead.

FEMALE GUEST A
She faked a pregnancy to trap him. Why not fake a suicide?

The woman clutches her head, her expression pained and confused.

SU SHANGJING
Where is this? Where is my child?

She stumbles toward Yan Jinchuan and grabs his arm.

YAN JINCHUAN
(shaking her off)
Su Shangjing, what trick is this?

SU SHANGJING
(desperate, confused)
Su Shangjing? No... I'm...

She looks down at her unfamiliar hands, then at the portrait.

SU SHANGJING
(whispering)
Who is Su Shangjing?

title: The Mom Who Braves All Odds
description: A martial arts master must choose between her sacred secret manual and her daughter's life when betrayed by her closest allies.
context:
Title: The Mom Who Braves All Odds
Description: A martial arts master must choose between her sacred secret manual and her daughter's life when betrayed by her closest allies.

EXT. ANCIENT FOREST - NIGHT

Ancient forest at night. Moonlight reveals a fallen monument. JIN YANCHUAN, masked, drops from the stone and blocks BAI XIUCHUN, in white warrior robes.

JIN YANCHUAN
The Biaoyue Manual. Last chance.

BAI XIUCHUN's stance is unreadable. JIN YANCHUAN attacks. Their exchange ends in three strikes. Bai Xiuchun's palm drops him.

JIN YANCHUAN
(gasping)
The Shadowless Hand...

BAI XIUCHUN
Not today.

Torchlight flares through trees. YING LENGYUE arrives with SUBORDINATES. In their crane's cargo net: GU HONG and daughter JIAJIA, bound.

JIAJIA
Mom!

BAI XIUCHUN
(shocked)
What is this?

SUBORDINATE
Hold!

GU HONG
(bleeding)
She poisoned Master. The manual can't—

YING LENGYUE
(icy)
Enough.

She snaps Gu Hong's neck. He falls.

JIAJIA
(screaming)
Dad!

BAI XIUCHUN
(whisper)
No...
continuation:
YING LENGYUE
Manual or daughter. Choose.

She squeezes Jiajia's shoulder. The girl bites back a cry.

YING LENGYUE
(to Jin Yanchuan)
Uncle. We've won.

She tosses an empty scroll case at Bai Xiuchun's feet.

YING LENGYUE
The Kunshan School ends tonight.

BAI XIUCHUN
(desperate)
Jiajia...

The crane lifts away. Darkness swallows their cries.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

Rain slashes across tombs. BAI XIUCHUN and QING HU stand before GU HONG's grave.

BAI XIUCHUN (V.O.)
They taught me to save thousands. Not one.

She pulls the Biaoyue Manual from her robes. Forces it into Qing Hu's hands.

BAI XIUCHUN (V.O.)
Kunshan is dead. Let its ghosts remember.

She touches the tombstone. Rain streams down her face.

BAI XIUCHUN
(to the storm)
Bai Xiuchun is dead.

EXT. WANGFU GUEST HOUSE - DAY

SUPER: FIFTEEN YEARS LATER

Mist clings to a courtyard. APENG practices Wing Chun on a wooden dummy. LIN JUNRU watches from above, sharp-eyed. She fingers a jade pendant.

LIN JUNRU
(quiet)
Jiajia would be twenty-four.

She tucks the pendant away. Descends into morning light.

title: Bringing a Prince to the Modern Era
description: A delivery girl accidentally travels to ancient times and brings a prince back to the modern world.
context:
Title: Bringing a Prince to the Modern Era
Description: A delivery girl accidentally travels to ancient times and brings a prince back to the modern world.

EXT. FILM STUDIO - DAY

On an open field, a yellow electric cart speeds past.

YE ZHAOXI (V.O.)
Two minutes left on the timer.

YE ZHAOXI, a girl wearing a yellow delivery uniform with twin ponytails, stops the cart and grabs the food delivery and her phone. A jade pendant hangs at her neck.

YE ZHAOXI (V.O.)
Last order. Rent's locked.

YE ZHAOXI runs into a large building.

INT. FILM STUDIO CORRIDOR - DAY

YE ZHAOXI sprints through the corridor, passing various actors in costume.

YE ZHAOXI
(dodging through)
Sorry—excuse me!

PASSERBY A
Watch it!

A woman's voice comes from one room.

WOMAN (O.S.)
Dongmei, what are you doing?

In another room, a girl climbs onto a windowsill.

GIRL
Burn, my youth!

YE ZHAOXI continues running forward, passing a simulated airplane cabin set.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT (O.S.)
Ladies and gentlemen, our plane is experiencing turbulence, please remain calm.

INT. AIRPLANE SIMULATION CABIN - DAY

The DIRECTOR sits in front of monitors, watching the flight attendant actress performing.

DIRECTOR
Cut! Who told you to act like that? Can you be more realistic? Do it again!

The DIRECTOR sees YE ZHAOXI at the door.

DIRECTOR
What are you doing?

YE ZHAOXI
I'm delivering food.

DIRECTOR
(impatiently)
Food? Get out!

YE ZHAOXI is driven out. She looks down at her phone.

YE ZHAOXI
(to herself)
Wrong address...

She notices a door marked "HISTORICAL SOUNDSTAGE B-3" and pushes through.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT MILITARY TENT - DAY

The scene switches to an ancient battlefield, two armies at war.

ON SCREEN: 600 BC - KINGDOM OF DANZHU

Inside the military tent, PRINCE DANZHU wears armor, his back to a sand table. He turns around, his eyes resolute.

PRINCE DANZHU
(to the generals)
The Rong tribes raid our borders. We answer with steel. Today, Danzhu writes its legend!

GENERALS
Long live Danzhu! Long live the Prince!

Suddenly, YE ZHAOXI appears out of nowhere in the military tent. She looks around bewildered.

YE ZHAOXI
(quietly)
This is the spot.

The GENERALS and PRINCE DANZHU stare at her in shock.

YE ZHAOXI
(holding up the delivery bag)
Food delivery.

PRINCE DANZHU
Dismissed.

GENERALS
Yes!

The generals leave. Only PRINCE DANZHU and YE ZHAOXI remain in the tent.

YE ZHAOXI
(handing over the food)
Hello, your delivery has arrived. Remember to give me a five-star review.

She looks curiously at the sand table.

YE ZHAOXI
Wow, your crew made this map so detailed, really authentic. Where's the hidden camera? It's really well hidden.

She reaches out to touch PRINCE DANZHU's armor.

PRINCE DANZHU
(grabbing her hand)
Identify yourself. How did you enter this tent?

YE ZHAOXI
(in pain)
Dude, ow ow ow! Do all you actors get this into your roles?

PRINCE DANZHU restrains her, and they end up in an intimate position close together.

PRINCE DANZHU
If you don't answer, you're a spy.

YE ZHAOXI
Just because you're handsome doesn't mean you can do whatever you want! Are you harassing me? Let go!

PRINCE DANZHU
I have ways to make you talk.

INT. ANCIENT MILITARY TENT - CONTINUOUS

A black-clad ASSASSIN suddenly bursts in.

ASSASSIN
Prince Danzhu, die!

The ASSASSIN swings his blade. PRINCE DANZHU immediately shields YE ZHAOXI behind him. As he turns, the jade pendant on YE ZHAOXI's neck emits a brilliant light.

Space-time distorts, and they are both engulfed by the light.

EXT. OUTSIDE FILM STUDIO - DAY

The light fades. PRINCE DANZHU and YE ZHAOXI appear on a modern street. PRINCE DANZHU looks around in shock at the unfamiliar environment.

PRINCE DANZHU
What place is this?

YE ZHAOXI
(impatiently)
Are all the people in your crew like this? All this fighting and killing.

PRINCE DANZHU
Woman, I ask, you answer. How far is this place from Danzhu?

YE ZHAOXI
Danzhu? That was over two thousand years ago.

PRINCE DANZHU
(shocked)
You're saying Danzhu no longer exists?

YE ZHAOXI
Yeah. It's ancient history.

PRINCE DANZHU staggers back, unable to believe it.

PRINCE DANZHU
Two thousand years have already passed...

YE ZHAOXI looks at his devastated expression and freezes.

YE ZHAOXI
No way? You're really the Prince of Danzhu?

They look at each other. The pendant is now dark and lifeless. Both are in extreme shock.
group_id: bringing a prince to the modern era

title: People Who Can't Be Warmed Don't Need to Be Kept
description: A woman endures eight years with a boyfriend who prioritizes his "white moonlight" over her, even abandoning her on her birthday.
context:
Title: People Who Can't Be Warmed Don't Need to Be Kept
Description: A woman endures eight years with a boyfriend who prioritizes his "white moonlight" over her, even abandoning her on her birthday.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

YE NINGYU and QIN RUNIAN stand together. YE NINGYU's expression is calm, practiced.

YE NINGYU (V.O.)
Eight years of learning to look away while he reaches for someone else. My boyfriend's "white moonlight"—the girl he could never forget. She gets his best smiles. I get the leftovers.

ZHANG KEKE jumps onto QIN RUNIAN's back from behind, wrapping her arms around his neck.

ZHANG KEKE
Penalty for being late! Ten push-ups with me on your back.

QIN RUNIAN
(doting)
You'll break me.

ZHANG KEKE
That's what you said last time.

ZHANG KEKE notices YE NINGYU. She stays on his back.

ZHANG KEKE
Oh. Ningyu. Didn't see you there. Brother Nian and I are just doing our usual. You don't mind, right?

YE NINGYU
(smiling faintly)
Why would I? You're family.

QIN RUNIAN's smile fades. He lowers ZHANG KEKE.

QIN RUNIAN
You're being dramatic.

ZHANG KEKE
We played that game months ago, this is just our thing. You're not still upset about your birthday yesterday, are you? I'll give him back, promise.

YE NINGYU
Keep him. I'm done sharing.
continuation:
INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT

ONE DAY EARLIER

YE NINGYU wears a birthday crown, sitting before a cake with candles. She closes her eyes.

YE NINGYU
Please let this year be different.

QIN RUNIAN's phone RINGS. He checks it—ZHANG KEKE's photo lights the screen. He answers.

QIN RUNIAN
Keke? What's wrong?

ZHANG KEKE (O.S.)
(sobbing)
He left me. I can't—I don't know what to—

QIN RUNIAN
I'll be right there.

He stands to leave. YE NINGYU's hand catches his wrist.

YE NINGYU
Don't. Please.

QIN RUNIAN
She needs me.

YE NINGYU
I need you. It's my birthday.

QIN RUNIAN
(pulling away)
And she just had her heart broken. Don't be selfish.

YE NINGYU
If you walk out that door—

QIN RUNIAN
(furious, careless)
Stop acting like a child!

He knocks the birthday crown from YE NINGYU's head. It clatters to the floor. He leaves without looking back.

QIN RUNIAN
(into phone)
I'm coming, Keke. Stay on the line.

YE NINGYU watches him go. She picks up the crown. It bends in her hands.

YE NINGYU (V.O.)
Eight years. For this.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

YE NINGYU places a box by the door. Inside: QIN RUNIAN's keys, a phone charger, their graduation photo. She surveys the apartment—his things stacked, hers already gone.

Her phone lights up. QIN RUNIAN calling. She declines. Blocks the number.

The birthday crown sits in the trash, glitter dulled.

YE NINGYU (V.O.)
The heart doesn't break. It calcifies. And then it walks away.

She exits. The door locks with a final CLICK.
group_id: people who can't be warmed don't need to be kept

title: After the Marriage Swap, My Sister Regrets Everything
description: A successful woman is murdered by her jealous sister at her award ceremony, only to be reborn one year earlier on the day of their arranged marriages, giving her a chance to change their fates.
context:
Title: After the Marriage Swap, My Sister Regrets Everything
Description: A successful woman is murdered by her jealous sister at her award ceremony, only to be reborn one year earlier on the day of their arranged marriages, giving her a chance to change their fates.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY VENUE - NIGHT

Golden confetti rains down. SU LI, elegant in a champagne gown, cradles the Entrepreneur of the Year trophy center stage, her smile genuine but tired.

SU LI (V.O.)
The day I reached the top. Finally.

SU LI traces the trophy's engraving—a moment of quiet triumph. Then her spine straightens. A familiar presence.

SU LI (V.O.)
She couldn't let me have even this.

SU XUE'ER emerges from the wings, stained trench coat over trembling shoulders, a kitchen knife glinting in her white-knuckled grip.

SU LI (V.O.)
My sister. Coming to collect what she thinks I stole.

SU LI's breath catches. She steps back, but the podium blocks her escape.

SU XUE'ER
(whispering, desperate)
It should have been mine.

She lunges. The blade sinks into SU LI's side. No scream—just a sharp exhale. SU LI clutches the wound, crimson blooming between her fingers. She collapses, the trophy clattering beside her.

SU XUE'ER stares at her bloody hands, a sob-choked laugh escaping.

A BODYGUARD vaults onstage, weapon drawn. One shot.

SU XUE'ER jerks, crumples beside her sister. Their eyes lock—one filled with regret, the other with resignation.

ON SCREEN: What if we could choose again?

The image fractures like shattered glass. Time rewinds.

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

One year earlier. A lavish garden wedding. SU LI and SU XUE'ER stand in identical gowns, but their postures tell different stories—SU LI rigid with duty, SU XUE'ER practically vibrating with anticipation.

SU LI (V.O.)
We stood here once. Before everything burned.

SU XUE'ER beams as she clasps the red silk with JI HAN ZHOU, the tech mogul in his wheelchair, his smile thin and unreadable.
continuation:
INT. HUMBLE WEDDING ROOM - DAY

SU LI sits beside JIANG HAO on a creaking bed, red double happiness peeling at the corners. He offers her tea with careful, calloused hands.

JIANG HAO
(quietly)
I'll make this right. Somehow.

SU LI studies his earnest face, almost believing him.

INT. BOARDROOM - NIGHT

JI HAN ZHOU's empire collapses. Bankers pound the table. SU XUE'ER barges in, hair wild, as a notification lights up her phone: ASSETS FROZEN.

INT. BURNING PENTHOUSE - NIGHT

Flames consume Ji Corporation's headquarters. SU XUE'ER claws at the window, watching her diamond bracelet melt into slag. She laughs, high and broken.

SU XUE'ER
(to the flames)
I chose this! I chose him!

EXT. SNOWY STREET - NIGHT

SU XUE'ER huddles in a designer coat turned inside-out, the label hidden. She shoves her last possession—a gold wedding band—at a street vendor, who tosses it back: "Fake."

INT. AWARD CEREMONY VENUE - DAY

JIANG HAO stands stage-side, filming SU LI's speech on his phone, pride and something like fear in his eyes. She catches his gaze mid-sentence, falters, then smiles for real.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY VENUE - NIGHT

Blood spreads across the stage. SU LI's vision tunnels. Her fingers find the trophy—cold, meaningless.

SU LI (V.O.)
Jiang Hao's empire. My empire. We built it from nothing. She destroyed it from spite.

The shattered glass effect intensifies.

INT. SU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

SU LI gasps, jerking upright on the sofa. White dress. Living parents. The scent of her mother's perfume—suffocatingly familiar.

SU MOTHER (O.S.)
—listening? Honestly, Su Li, you're so—

SU MOTHER and SU FATHER loom over her, faces rearranged into concerned masks.

SU MOTHER
That poor boy is waiting downstairs. You'll do as you're told.

SU FATHER
(tamping his pipe, not looking up)
Xue'er's made her choice. Don't embarrass us.

SU LI's knuckles whiten on the sofa arm. The phantom pain lingers.

SU LI (V.O.)
The fire. Jiang Hao's first algorithm. The date on the newspaper. All here. All real.

SU MOTHER
(leaning close, voice syrupy)
Be a good daughter. Your sister deserves this chance.

SU LI's eyes lift. Not to her mother—to the family portrait above the mantle. Her own face, carefully blurred in the background.

SU LI (V.O.)
Or maybe I deserve it.

SU LI stands. Her spine straightens with a deliberation that makes her parents exchange a glance.

SU LI
Let me marry Ji Han Zhou.

SU FATHER's pipe freezes mid-tamp. SU MOTHER's smile cracks.

SU XUE'ER appears in the doorway, pink dress too tight, victory already written on her face until she hears the words.

SU XUE'ER
What? No—I'll take Jiang Hao.

Her voice is too quick. Desperate. She catches herself, smooths her expression.

SU XUE'ER
(carefully, to her parents)
He's... more suitable. For me.

SU LI watches her sister twist the narrative. The trophy's phantom weight in her hand. The knife's phantom pain in her side.

SU LI
Then it's settled.

She extends her hand—not to her parents, to SU XUE'ER. A mirror of the red silk ritual.

SU LI
Sisters shouldn't fight over fate.

SU XUE'ER stares at the offered hand like it's a weapon.
group_id: after the marriage swap, my sister regrets everything

title: After Letting Go, The Scumbag Begs Me For Forgiveness
description: A former heiress, now sick and destitute, confronts her ex-lover on his wedding day, seeking help for her illness while uncovering the truth of her downfall.
context:
Title: After Letting Go, The Scumbag Begs Me For Forgiveness
Description: A former heiress, now sick and destitute, confronts her ex-lover on his wedding day, seeking help for her illness while uncovering the truth of her downfall.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

MU NINGNING stumbles forward, her face pale, clutching a medical report. She gasps for breath as a passing patient nears—she flinches, crashing into the wall. Pain doubles her over. She leans there, trembling.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

MU NINGNING sits across from the DOCTOR.

DOCTOR
Your balance is sixty thousand in arrears. The pharmacy won't release your ART.

MU NINGNING
(voice thin)
My mother's estate—

DOCTOR
—was liquidated two years ago. The hospital isn't a charity.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

MU NINGNING leans against the wall, a tear sliding down. She opens the report: "HIV Antibody Positive" in bold type. She crumples it, then forces it flat, smoothing the paper with obsessive care.

INT. NURSE STATION - DAY

MU NINGNING passes the nurse station. TWO NURSES gossip, not bothering to whisper.

NURSE A
That's Mu Ningning? The one whose mother built this wing?

NURSE B
Now look at her. AIDS, broke, and alone.

NURSE A
I heard she gave everything to some man.

NURSE B
The Horizon Group CEO. He Jingchen.

Mu Ningning freezes mid-step, then keeps walking.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - DAY

The TV broadcasts news. Photos of HE JINGCHEN and FANG JINGYI in evening wear.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
He Jingchen, Horizon Group's youngest billionaire, and fiancée Fang Jingyi prepare for their wedding at Wanhao Grand Hotel...

Mu Ningning watches from the shadows. She looks down at her phone—cracked screen, eviction notice in her texts. She twists the jade bracelet on her wrist, a gift from her mother. She doesn't take it off.

EXT. WEDDING HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

MU NINGNING approaches the service entrance. A BODYGUARD blocks her path.

BODYGUARD
Private event. Move along.

She tries to dart past. He shoves her back—she falls hard against a marble planter. Blood trickles from her palm.

The main doors open.

HE JINGCHEN and FANG JINGYI emerge—him in a suit, her in a silk robe over her wedding dress, phone in hand as if interrupted.

HE JINGCHEN
Mu Ningning?

MU NINGNING
(struggling up)
He Jingchen. Please. Just five minutes.

FANG JINGYI
(contemptuous)
She's here for money. Isn't that right?

MU NINGNING
The company transfer. You signed for my medical trust.

HE JINGCHEN
(leaning against the wall)
That trust was contingent on you remaining an employee. You quit, remember?

MU NINGNING
You told me to sign over my shares first. Then you'd marry me.

FANG JINGYI
And you believed him? How pathetic.

MU NINGNING
(to He Jingchen)
I have nothing left. Just lend me enough for the medication. I'll disappear.

HE JINGCHEN
Nothing left? You have your mother's jade.

Her hand flies to the bracelet.

HE JINGCHEN (CONT'D)
But that's not enough. You want my money, you earn it.

He takes out a black card. Waves it slowly.

HE JINGCHEN (CONT'D)
Kneel. Lick my shoe clean. Then we'll discuss your allowance.

Mu Ningning stares at him. For the first time, her tears stop. Something behind her eyes hardens.

Her knees begin to bend.
